996机制对从业人员产生负面影响
exercises.explanation: Casual register: 真不是人干的 ("this isn't fit for humans") is colloquial complaint. The other options are essay/formal versions of the same idea.

exercises.prompt: Build a compound sentence: "Although the salary is high, the pressure is enormous" (尽管...但是)
exercises.answer: 尽管 工资 很 高 但是 压力 非常 大

exercises.prompt: "打工人" (dǎ gōng rén) refers to ___
exercises.explanation: 打工人 — viral meme term. Working folks calling themselves "the laboring people" with a mix of pride and self-mockery. 打工人, 打工魂, 打工都是人上人.

exercises.prompt: the workplace stress vocab
Best translation for "I've been overworked recently":
options: All of the above could work
exercises.answer: All of the above could work
exercises.explanation: Spoken Chinese has many ways to express the same complaint at different registers — 太累了 (casual), 工作过度 (medical/formal), 压力很大 (stress-focused).

exercises.prompt: Build "The more I work overtime, the more exhausted I become" (越...越)
exercises.answer: 我 越 加班 越 累

exercises.prompt: Your boss WeChats: 这个项目今晚能搞定吗？ Pick the appropriate reply for a formal workplace.
exercises.answer: 好的，我会尽力今晚完成。
acceptableAnswers: 好的 我会尽力今晚完成
好的，我尽力在今晚完成
好的，我会努力今晚完成
exercises.explanation: 好的 + 尽力 + 完成 is the standard non-committal-but-positive reply. Casual 行 / 没问题 sounds too breezy when the boss is pushing a deadline.

exercises.prompt: Tap the workplace term you hear
exercises.explanation: 加班 (jiā bān, work overtime) and 上班 (shàng bān, go to work) start with different first syllables. The complaint volume is also a clue — 加班 carries more sigh.

lessons.title: Internet labor slang: 内卷, 躺平, 裸辞
lessons.description: From the involution treadmill to lying flat — newer workplace memes

exercises.prompt: the internet labor slang

pairs.right: Involution / cutthroat competition for diminishing returns
Letting it rot / phoning it in

exercises.prompt: Build "He has chosen to lie flat"
Build "Young people today are in really fierce involution"
exercises.answer: 现在 年轻 人 内卷 得 很 厉害
exercises.explanation: 内卷 used as a verb takes 得 + degree complement, like other stative verbs.

exercises.prompt: Tap the term you hear
exercises.explanation: 内卷 (nèi juǎn, involution) and 内涵 (nèi hán, connotation / hidden meaning) sound similar — listen for the second syllable. 卷 has a falling-rising tone; 涵 has a rising tone.

exercises.prompt: "他干脆裸辞了" means ___
exercises.answer: He just quit outright with no backup plan
acceptableAnswers: He simply quit without a backup
exercises.explanation: 裸辞 (luǒ cí) — literally "naked resign". 干脆 (gān cuì) here = "just outright".

exercises.prompt: Best translation of "I'm not lying flat, I'm just resting":
options: 我不是躺平，我只是在休息
exercises.answer: 我不是躺平，我只是在休息
exercises.explanation: Common comeback when accused of 躺平. The 不是X，只是Y frame distances yourself from the negative label.

exercises.prompt: Build "In an involution environment, even hard work can't change anything" (即使...也)
exercises.answer: 在 内卷 的 环境 里 即使 努力 也 改变 不 了 什么

exercises.prompt: "卷不动了" (juǎn bù dòng le) means ___
exercises.answer: I can't keep up with the involution anymore
acceptableAnswers: I'm too exhausted to compete anymore
I can't run on this treadmill anymore
exercises.explanation: 卷不动 — potential complement: 卷 (compete in involution) + 不动 (can't physically move). 了 marks the give-up moment.

exercises.prompt: the labor-attitude meme to its English vibe

pairs.right: Letting it rot / phoning it in

exercises.prompt: Build "I'd rather lie flat than continue with the involution"
exercises.answer: 我 宁愿 躺平 也 不 想 继续 内卷
exercises.explanation: 宁愿X也不Y — "would rather X than Y". A B2 staple for stating preferences strongly.

exercises.prompt: Pick the casual / colloquial register:
options: 鉴于工作环境过于内卷化，本人选择以躺平方式回应
据观察当下职场内卷现象较为严重
exercises.explanation: 我不卷了，我躺平 is exactly how a friend would say it on WeChat. The other options are mock-formal essay or news-register variations.

exercises.prompt: "鸡娃" (jī wá) refers to ___
exercises.explanation: 鸡娃 literally "chicken-blood the kid" — a slang verb for parents who heavily structure their kids' study schedules with extracurriculars and tutoring.

exercises.prompt: Build "Although the older generation can't understand 'lying flat', young people understand each other" (尽管...但是)
exercises.answer: 尽管 上 一 代 不 理解 躺平 但是 年轻 人 互相 理解

lessons.title: AI & the future
lessons.description: 人工智能 and the 用 X 来 Y instrument pattern

exercises.prompt: What does "人工智能" (rén gōng zhì néng) mean?
Build "AI will change our way of life" (news/tech register)
exercises.answer: 人工智能 将 改变 我们 的 生活 方式
exercises.explanation: 将 (jiāng) is the formal/news-register "will" — preferred over 会 in tech and journalistic writing.

exercises.prompt: "机器人" (jī qì rén) means ___
Best translation for "Many jobs may be replaced by AI":
options: 很多工作可能会被人工智能取代
exercises.answer: 很多工作可能会被人工智能取代
exercises.explanation: 被 marks the passive: the jobs are replaced (by AI).

exercises.prompt: Build "I use my phone to pay" (用 X 来 Y instrument pattern)
exercises.answer: 我 用 手机 来 支付
exercises.explanation: 用 X 来 Y — "use X to do Y". X is the instrument, Y is the action. 来 links them; in casual speech it's often dropped (我用手机支付), but 来 makes the instrumental relationship explicit.

exercises.prompt: Pick the best translation of "We can use AI to solve many problems":
options: 我们可以用人工智能来解决很多问题
我们人工智能很多问题
我们解决人工智能问题
exercises.answer: 我们可以用人工智能来解决很多问题

exercises.prompt: the AI / tech term
"机器翻译越来越准确" means ___
exercises.answer: Machine translation is getting more and more accurate
acceptableAnswers: Machine translation keeps getting more accurate

exercises.prompt: Build "Although AI is powerful, it can't replace humans" (尽管...但是)
exercises.answer: 尽管 人工智能 很 强大 但是 不 能 取代 人类

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "AI not only changes work but also changes how we live" (不仅...而且):
options: 人工智能不仅改变工作，而且改变我们的生活方式
人工智能但是工作生活
exercises.answer: 人工智能不仅改变工作，而且改变我们的生活方式

exercises.prompt: "AI 抢 工作" (AI qiǎng gōng zuò) — what does this mean?
exercises.explanation: 抢 = snatch / grab. Casual/news-headline phrasing for the AI-replaces-jobs anxiety.

exercises.prompt: Build "Even if AI develops fast, ethics issues still need to be considered" (即使...也)
exercises.answer: 即使 人工智能 发展 得 很 快 也 需要 考虑 伦理 问题

exercises.prompt: Tap the AI-related word you hear
exercises.explanation: 算法 (suàn fǎ) — algorithm. Easy to confuse with 算数 (count / arithmetic). The second syllable is the giveaway.

lessons.title: Dialogue: Smartphone troubleshooting with support
lessons.description: Politely describe a phone issue, hedge, and ask about repair cost

exercises.prompt: Calling customer support about a phone that keeps freezing

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: 您好，请问您的手机出了什么问题？(Nín hǎo, qǐngwèn nín de shǒujī chū le shénme wèntí?)
turns.spokenText: 您好，请问您的手机出了什么问题？

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Describe the issue politely (formal register).
options: 您好，我的手机最近经常突然死机，重启也没用。(Nín hǎo, wǒ de shǒujī zuìjìn jīngcháng tūrán sǐjī, chóngqǐ yě méi yòng.)
嘿哥们手机老挂掉烦死了。(Hēi gēmen shǒujī lǎo guàdiào fán sǐ le.)
手机突然然后但是死机也但是。(Shǒujī tūrán ránhòu dànshì sǐjī yě dànshì.)
turns.answer: 您好，我的手机最近经常突然死机，重启也没用。(Nín hǎo, wǒ de shǒujī zuìjìn jīngcháng tūrán sǐjī, chóngqǐ yě méi yòng.)

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: 请问您上次更新系统是什么时候？(Qǐngwèn nín shàng cì gēngxīn xìtǒng shì shénme shíhòu?)
turns.spokenText: 请问您上次更新系统是什么时候？

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Answer with a hedge — you're not sure.
options: 大概是上个月吧，具体日期我记不清了。(Dàgài shì shàng gè yuè ba, jùtǐ rìqī wǒ jì bù qīng le.)
我绝对一百分百昨天更新的。(Wǒ juéduì yībǎi fēn bǎi zuótiān gēngxīn de.)
更新没有大概因为上月。(Gēngxīn méiyǒu dàgài yīnwèi shàng yuè.)
turns.answer: 大概是上个月吧，具体日期我记不清了。(Dàgài shì shàng gè yuè ba, jùtǐ rìqī wǒ jì bù qīng le.)

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: 好的，请您先尝试在设置里清除缓存。(Hǎo de, qǐng nín xiān chángshì zài shèzhì lǐ qīngchú huǎncún.)
turns.spokenText: 好的，请您先尝试在设置里清除缓存。

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Fill in the polite hedge — 'I'm afraid'.
turns.after: 清完之后问题还在。(Hǎo de, búguò wǒ ___ qīng wán zhīhòu wèntí hái zài.)
turns.answer: 担心

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: 如果还有问题，建议您带到门店检测。(Rúguǒ hái yǒu wèntí, jiànyì nín dài dào méndiàn jiǎncè.)
turns.spokenText: 如果还有问题，建议您带到门店检测。

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Confirm and ask about cost.
options: 好的，请问检测大概需要多少费用？(Hǎo de, qǐngwèn jiǎncè dàgài xūyào duōshǎo fèiyòng?)
好那多少钱赶紧说快点。(Hǎo nà duōshǎo qián gǎnjǐn shuō kuài diǎn.)
费用不需要因为大概多少。(Fèiyòng bù xūyào yīnwèi dàgài duōshǎo.)
turns.answer: 好的，请问检测大概需要多少费用？(Hǎo de, qǐngwèn jiǎncè dàgài xūyào duōshǎo fèiyòng?)

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: 保修期内是免费的，您可以放心。(Bǎoxiū qī nèi shì miǎnfèi de, nín kěyǐ fàngxīn.)
turns.spokenText: 保修期内是免费的，您可以放心。

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: 感谢您的来电，祝您生活愉快。(Gǎnxiè nín de láidiàn, zhù nín shēnghuó yúkuài.)
turns.spokenText: 感谢您的来电，祝您生活愉快。

topics.title: Education & learning
topics.description: School systems, the gaokao, and lifelong study

lessons.title: School levels
lessons.description: From 小学 to 大学

exercises.prompt: the school level
What does "上课" (shàng kè) mean?
options: Go to class / class is in session
exercises.answer: Go to class / class is in session

exercises.prompt: "毕业" (bì yè) means ___
the school-life term
What does "补习班" (bǔ xí bān) mean?
exercises.explanation: 补习班 — supplementary tutoring class, central to Chinese after-school culture (until the 2021 双减 reform restricted them).

exercises.prompt: Build "Tomorrow we have a math test"
exercises.answer: 明天 我们 有 数学 考试

exercises.prompt: "开学" (kāi xué) means ___
exercises.answer: School starts / start of the term

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "My younger brother is in his second year of junior high":
exercises.explanation: 上 + grade — the verb "to be in (a grade)". 初二 is the abbreviation for 初中二年级 (junior-high year 2). Same goes for 高一, 高二, 高三.

exercises.prompt: Build "Studying not only takes time, but also takes energy" (不仅...而且)
exercises.answer: 学习 不仅 需要 时间 而且 需要 精力

exercises.prompt: the school-level abbreviation
"博士" (bó shì) means ___
Tap the term you hear
exercises.explanation: 高考 (gāo kǎo) — the dreaded national college-entrance exam. Don't confuse with 高中 (gāo zhōng, senior high).

lessons.title: The gaokao
lessons.description: 高考 — the test that decides everything

exercises.prompt: What is "高考" (gāo kǎo)?
Build "He studies very hard every day to prepare for the gaokao"
exercises.answer: 他 每天 都 很 努力 学习 准备 高考

exercises.prompt: the term
"考上了" (kǎo shàng le) means ___
exercises.answer: Got in / passed and got admitted
exercises.explanation: 上 here is a result complement: tested-onto = got in.

exercises.prompt: What does "应试教育" (yìng shì jiào yù) refer to?
exercises.explanation: 应试教育 — the Chinese term for the exam-cramming model. Frequently critiqued in op-eds. Contrast with 素质教育 ("holistic / whole-person education").

exercises.prompt: the gaokao culture term

pairs.right: Repeat senior year to retake gaokao

exercises.prompt: Build "In order to take the gaokao, he gave up many things"
exercises.answer: 为 了 高考 他 放弃 了 很 多 东西

exercises.prompt: "千军万马过独木桥" describes the gaokao because ___
exercises.answer: Thousands of soldiers crossing a single-plank bridge — fierce competition
acceptableAnswers: An army crossing a one-plank bridge
Huge numbers competing for few spots
exercises.explanation: 千军万马过独木桥 — classic chengyu metaphor for the gaokao bottleneck.

exercises.prompt: Pick the most NUANCED critique of exam-oriented education:
options: 应试教育虽然能筛选学生，但是忽视了创造力的培养
exercises.answer: 应试教育虽然能筛选学生，但是忽视了创造力的培养
exercises.explanation: Concede a point (能筛选学生) then criticize (忽视了创造力的培养). The 虽然...但是 frame is the standard B2 essay move.

exercises.prompt: Build "He has been preparing for the gaokao for three years" (verb-doubling for duration)
exercises.answer: 他 准备 高考 准备 了 三 年

exercises.prompt: "我不想再卷了" (in education context) means ___
exercises.answer: I don't want to compete in this rat race anymore
acceptableAnswers: I don't want to keep grinding
I'm tired of this academic competition
exercises.explanation: 卷 = participate in 内卷 (involution). 再...了 = anymore.

exercises.prompt: Tap the gaokao-culture word you hear
exercises.explanation: 状元 (zhuàng yuán) — historically the imperial-exam top scorer; now the title for each province's top gaokao scorer. 4th tone + 2nd tone.

lessons.title: Studying abroad
lessons.description: 出国留学 — the dream of many

exercises.prompt: What does "留学" (liú xué) mean?
Build "My older sister is studying abroad in the US"
exercises.answer: 我 姐姐 在 美国 留学

exercises.prompt: "奖学金" (jiǎng xué jīn) means ___
the studying-abroad term
What does "海归" (hǎi guī) literally and figuratively mean?
options: Sea turtle / Chinese person who studied abroad and returned
exercises.answer: Sea turtle / Chinese person who studied abroad and returned
exercises.explanation: Pun on 海龟 (sea turtle, same pronunciation). 海归 = those who 'return from overseas'. Cultural shorthand for ambitious returnees.

exercises.prompt: Build "She got admitted to a top US university"
exercises.answer: 她 被 美国 一 所 顶尖 大学 录取 了
exercises.explanation: 被 marks the passive: she 'was admitted'. 所 is the measure word for schools/houses.

exercises.prompt: "出国留学" means ___
Best translation for "Studying abroad isn't just for academics, it's also a life experience" (不仅...而且 / 还):
options: 留学不仅是为了学习，还是一种人生经历
exercises.answer: 留学不仅是为了学习，还是一种人生经历

exercises.prompt: Build "Although the cost of studying abroad is high, the experience is worth it" (虽然...但是)
exercises.answer: 虽然 留学 费用 很 高 但是 经历 很 值得

exercises.prompt: "我想去国外开开眼界" means ___
exercises.answer: I want to go abroad and broaden my horizons
acceptableAnswers: I want to go overseas to widen my view
I want to broaden my horizons abroad
exercises.explanation: 开眼界 — "open one's eyes/scope". The doubled verb 开开 softens it: "have a look" / "check it out".

exercises.prompt: the application-process step
Tap the term you hear
exercises.explanation: 留学 (liú xué) — to study abroad. The first character is 留 (stay/remain), implying "stay (overseas) to study".

lessons.title: Lifelong learning
lessons.description: Talk about what and why you study

exercises.prompt: Build "I think learning a foreign language is very important"
exercises.answer: 我 觉得 学 一 门 外语 非常 重要

exercises.prompt: Which best translates "I've studied Chinese for three years"?
exercises.explanation: Verb-duplication pattern: V-object V-了-time. The verb gets repeated to take the duration phrase.

exercises.prompt: "活到老，学到老" means ___
exercises.answer: Live to old age, learn to old age
exercises.explanation: A famous proverb — the closest English equivalent is "you're never too old to learn".

exercises.prompt: the online-learning term
What does "自学成才" (zì xué chéng cái) mean?
exercises.explanation: Chengyu: 自学 (self-study) + 成才 (become talented). Used to praise self-made experts.

exercises.prompt: Build "The more I study, the more I realize how little I know"
exercises.answer: 我 越 学 越 发现 自己 知道 得 太 少

exercises.prompt: "学历" (xué lì) means ___
Best translation for "Online learning is convenient, but it lacks interaction":
options: 网课很方便，但是缺少互动
exercises.answer: 网课很方便，但是缺少互动

exercises.prompt: Build "Even if you graduate, you should keep learning" (即使...也)
exercises.answer: 即使 毕 业 了 也 应该 继续 学习

exercises.prompt: "知识就是力量" (zhī shí jiù shì lì liàng) means ___
Build a casual recommendation: "I think there are many free courses online, you should check them out"
exercises.answer: 我 觉得 网上 有 很 多 免费 课程 你 应该 看 看

exercises.prompt: Tap the lifelong-learning term you hear
exercises.spokenText: 终 身 学 习
options: 终 身 学 习
中 学 学 习
终 究 学 习
众 生 学 习
exercises.answer: 终 身 学 习
exercises.explanation: 终身学习 (zhōng shēn xué xí) — formal term for lifelong learning. 终身 = whole life. The casual equivalent would be 活到老学到老.

turns.speaker: teacher

turns.speaker: teacher

turns.answer: 我们也许可以让他每周写一篇小日记。(Wǒmen yěxǔ kěyǐ ràng tā měi zhōu xiě yī piān xiǎo rìjì.)

turns.speaker: teacher
turns.text: 这个想法不错，我也会在课上多请他发言。(Zhège xiǎngfǎ bùcuò, wǒ yě huì zài kè shàng duō qǐng tā fāyán.)

lessons.title: How long have you been doing it?
lessons.description: Time-duration with verb-doubling: 我 学 中文 学 了 三 年

exercises.prompt: Why does 学 appear twice in "我学中文学了三年"?
options: When a verb has an object, you repeat the verb to attach a duration phrase
exercises.answer: When a verb has an object, you repeat the verb to attach a duration phrase
exercises.explanation: Pattern: Subject + V + Object + V + 了 + Duration. The doubled verb is what carries 了 and the time phrase.

exercises.prompt: Build "I have studied Chinese for three years"
exercises.answer: 我 学 中文 学 了 三 年

exercises.prompt: Build "We have known each other for ten years"
exercises.answer: 我们 认识 认识 了 十 年

exercises.prompt: Which sentence is GRAMMATICALLY WRONG?
options: 我看电视看了两个小时
exercises.explanation: If you keep the object 中文 right after the verb, you must repeat the verb for the duration: 学中文学了三年. Otherwise drop the object: 我学了三年中文.

exercises.prompt: "他打篮球打了一个下午" means ___
exercises.answer: He played basketball for an entire afternoon
acceptableAnswers: He spent a whole afternoon playing basketball
exercises.explanation: Same pattern: V (打) + Obj (篮球) + V (打) + 了 + duration (一个下午).

exercises.prompt: Build "They have been together for two years"
exercises.answer: 他们 在 一起 在 一起 了 两 年
exercises.explanation: Even multi-character predicates like 在一起 follow the doubling rule when a duration is added.

exercises.prompt: Which is the alternative form to verb-doubling for "I've studied Chinese for three years"?
exercises.explanation: Two equivalent forms: (1) S + V + 了 + duration + O — 我学了三年中文; (2) S + V + O + V + 了 + duration — 我学中文学了三年. Both are correct.

exercises.prompt: "我等了她两个小时" (no object, simpler form) means ___
exercises.answer: I waited for her for two hours
acceptableAnswers: I waited two hours for her
I spent two hours waiting for her
exercises.explanation: When a verb is intransitive (or the object is a person), the simpler S+V+了+(person)+duration works without doubling.

exercises.prompt: Build "I've worked at this company for ten years"
exercises.answer: 我 在 这 家 公司 工作 工作 了 十 年

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "How long have you studied Chinese?":
exercises.explanation: Same verb-doubling pattern in question form. Sentence-final 了 marks 'as of now'.

exercises.prompt: "我们认识三年了" means ___
exercises.answer: We've known each other for three years (and still do)
acceptableAnswers: We've known each other for three years
We've been friends for three years
exercises.explanation: 认识 (know someone) is a stative verb, so the duration attaches directly without doubling. The 了 at end marks ongoing state.

exercises.prompt: Tap the duration phrase you hear
exercises.spokenText: 学 了 三 年
options: 学 了 三 年
学 三 年 了
学 三 个 年
三 年 学 了
exercises.answer: 学 了 三 年
exercises.explanation: Two valid orders: 学了三年 (just completed/described) vs 学三年了 (still going). Listen for which you hear.

topics.title: Emotions in depth
topics.description: Beyond happy and sad — frustrated, moved, embarrassed, even-if-I

guide.intro: B2 emotions need B2 grammar. The patterns 即使…也 (even if…still) and 尽管 (although) let you say things like "even if I'm tired, I'll still finish" and "although I'm sad, I'm okay" — exactly the kind of nuance you start needing once you go past 我很高兴.

sections.text: 即使…也 — even if…still

即使 (jí shǐ) introduces a hypothetical or extreme condition; the second half always uses 也 (yě, "still") or 还 (hái) to mark that the result holds regardless. Without that 也, the sentence sounds incomplete to a native ear.

rows.pinyin: Jí shǐ xià yǔ, wǒ yě yào qù.
rows.translation: Even if it rains, I'll still go.

rows.pinyin: Jí shǐ hěn lèi, tā yě bù fàng qì.
rows.translation: Even if he's tired, he doesn't give up.

rows.source: 即使没有钱，我也很快乐。
rows.pinyin: Jí shǐ méi yǒu qián, wǒ yě hěn kuài lè.
rows.translation: Even without money, I'm still happy.

sections.text: 即使 is for hypotheticals ("even if it rains") — events that may or may not happen. 即便 (jí biàn) is a slightly more formal synonym you'll see in writing.
尽管…但是 — although

尽管 (jǐn guǎn) introduces an actual fact (not a hypothetical), and 但是 (dàn shì, "but") or 还是 (hái shi, "still") marks the contrasting follow-up. Use 尽管 when the first clause is true and the second clause is the surprise.

rows.source: 尽管下雨，他还是去跑步了。
rows.pinyin: Jǐn guǎn xià yǔ, tā hái shi qù pǎo bù le.
rows.translation: Although it was raining, he still went running.

rows.source: 尽管我们很努力，但是没有成功。
rows.pinyin: Jǐn guǎn wǒ men hěn nǔ lì, dàn shì méi yǒu chéng gōng.
rows.translation: Although we tried hard, we didn't succeed.

the discourse particle to its function

Build "I felt extremely disappointed today"

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "I'm slightly nervous" (mild):
exercises.explanation: Match degree to context: 有点 (a bit) is the mild option. The other three are all strong.

exercises.prompt: the emotion idiom to its meaning

pairs.right: Heart like being cut by a knife (devastating sorrow)

exercises.prompt: Build "That moment was incredibly awkward"

lessons.title: Even if (即使…也)
lessons.description: Stand firm against a hypothetical

exercises.prompt: Build "Even if it rains, I'll still go"
exercises.answer: 即使 下雨 我 也 要 去

exercises.prompt: Which sentence is GRAMMATICALLY WRONG?
exercises.explanation: 即使 must pair with 也 / 还 in the second clause. Dropping 也 leaves the sentence feeling unfinished.

exercises.prompt: "即使很累，他也不放弃" means ___
exercises.answer: Even when tired, he doesn't give up
acceptableAnswers: Even if he's tired, he won't give up
Even though tired, he doesn't give up

exercises.prompt: What's the obligatory partner of 即使?
exercises.explanation: 即使...也 / 还 is the locked frame. Without 也 / 还, the sentence sounds incomplete.

exercises.prompt: Build "Even if no one supports me, I'll still keep going"
exercises.answer: 即使 没 有 人 支持 我 我 也 会 坚持 下去

exercises.prompt: "即使没有钱，我也很快乐" means ___
exercises.answer: Even without money, I'm still happy
acceptableAnswers: Even if I have no money, I'm happy
I'm happy even when I don't have money

exercises.prompt: Pick the GRAMMATICALLY VALID 即使 sentence:
exercises.explanation: 即使 pairs only with 也 / 还 / 还是. 但是, 因为, 所以 don't fit.

exercises.prompt: Build "Even if you don't agree, I'll still do it"
exercises.answer: 即使 你 不 同意 我 也 会 这么 做

exercises.prompt: the conditional pattern to its meaning
"即便" (jí biàn) is a ___ synonym for 即使.
exercises.explanation: 即便 = same meaning as 即使, slightly preferred in written/essay register.

exercises.prompt: Build "Even if it costs a lot, this experience is worth it"
exercises.answer: 即使 花 很 多 钱 这 段 经历 也 值得

exercises.prompt: Tap the connector you hear
exercises.explanation: 即使 (jí shǐ, 2nd + 3rd tone) starts with the rising 即. 即便 also starts with 即 but has falling 便. Practice the contrast.

lessons.title: Although (尽管…但是)
lessons.description: Real-world contrast

exercises.prompt: When do you use 尽管 instead of 即使?
options: 尽管 = hypothetical; 即使 = real
尽管 = real fact; 即使 = hypothetical
exercises.answer: 尽管 = real fact; 即使 = hypothetical

exercises.prompt: Build "Although we tried hard, we didn't succeed"
exercises.answer: 尽管 我们 很 努力 但是 没有 成功
exercises.explanation: 尽管 X 但是 Y. The follow-up word can also be 还是 or 仍然 ("still") — e.g. 尽管下雨，他还是去了 / 尽管累，我仍然要做完.

exercises.prompt: "尽管下雨，他还是去跑步了" means ___
exercises.answer: Although it was raining, he still went running
acceptableAnswers: Even though it rained, he still went running
Despite the rain, he still went running

exercises.prompt: Tap the word you hear
exercises.explanation: 尽管 (jǐn guǎn) and 即使 (jí shǐ) both translate as "even though/if" — but they sound very different. 尽管 starts with a 3rd-tone 尽; 即使 starts with a 2nd-tone 即. Train the ear before the grammar.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence requires 尽管 (NOT 即使)? (a real fact)
exercises.explanation: If "I'm tired" is presented as a current real fact, use 尽管. The other three are hypotheticals — 即使 territory.

exercises.prompt: Build "Although I'm tired, I'll still finish my work" (尽管...还是)
exercises.answer: 尽管 我 很 累 我 还 是 会 做 完 工作

exercises.prompt: Convert formal 尽管 sentence: 尽管下雨，他还是去跑步了。 To CASUAL conversational form, swap 尽管 → ___
exercises.explanation: 虽然 is the everyday spoken equivalent of 尽管. 尽管 carries a slightly more written tone. Both pair with 但是 / 还是.

exercises.prompt: the contrast connector to its register
Build "Although the work is hard, the salary is good"
exercises.answer: 虽然 工作 很 辛苦 但是 工资 不错

exercises.prompt: "尽管如此" (jǐn guǎn rú cǐ) means ___
exercises.explanation: 尽管如此 — fixed phrase used at clause boundary to introduce a contrast. The 如此 means "like this".

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "Despite the heavy rain, the event still went ahead":
options: 尽管下大雨，活动还是照常进行
exercises.answer: 尽管下大雨，活动还是照常进行
exercises.explanation: 照常 (zhào cháng) — "as usual / as scheduled". A common essay-register word.

exercises.prompt: Build "Although she lost, she's still smiling"
exercises.answer: 虽然 她 输 了 但是 她 还 是 在 笑

lessons.title: How something makes you feel
lessons.description: 让 + person + emotion

exercises.prompt: What does "这部电影让我很感动" mean?
exercises.explanation: 让 (ràng) = to make / cause. "Movie makes me very moved." — a super common B2 frame.

exercises.prompt: Build "This news really shocked me"
exercises.answer: 这个 消息 让 我 非常 吃惊

exercises.prompt: "她的话让我很失望" means ___
acceptableAnswers: What she said really disappointed me
Her words made me very disappointed

exercises.prompt: Which is the most natural way to say "I felt wronged"?
exercises.explanation: 委屈 is a stative emotion, not an identity — "I am 委屈" with 是 doesn't work. Use 觉得 + 委屈.

exercises.prompt: the 让 + person + emotion pattern to its meaning

pairs.right: This movie is moving (makes one moved)

exercises.prompt: Build "What you did made me extremely disappointed"
exercises.answer: 你 做 的 事 让 我 非常 失望

exercises.prompt: "令" (lìng) is a more formal version of which word?
exercises.explanation: 令 = formal/written equivalent of 让 ("to make / cause"). 这令我感到惊讶 (this makes me surprised) is essay-register.

exercises.prompt: Which is the FORMAL register version?
exercises.explanation: 此事 (this matter), 本人 (I, formal), 令 (make), 深感 (deeply feel) — all formal/written swaps for casual 这事儿/我/让/觉得.

exercises.prompt: Build "This experience made me realize many things"
exercises.answer: 这 段 经历 让 我 明白 了 很 多 事情

exercises.prompt: "我对结果感到满意" means ___
acceptableAnswers: I feel content with the outcome
exercises.explanation: 对...感到 + emotion: a slightly more formal frame than 让 + person + emotion. Often used in writing.

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "It surprised me that he came":
Tap the emotion you hear
exercises.explanation: 委屈 (wěi qū) — feeling wronged or unfairly treated. The mid-falling 委 + falling 屈 distinguishes it.

lessons.title: Dialogue: Describing a complex reaction to a promotion
lessons.description: Name mixed feelings with 一方面…另一方面 and hedged emotion words

exercises.prompt: Friend asks why you look so torn about the news

turns.speaker: kai
turns.text: 听说你被升职了，怎么看起来心情有点复杂？(Tīngshuō nǐ bèi shēngzhí le, zěnme kàn qǐlái xīnqíng yǒudiǎn fùzá?)
turns.spokenText: 听说你被升职了，怎么看起来心情有点复杂？

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Express mixed feelings (one hand / on the other).
options: 一方面挺开心的，另一方面又怕做不好。(Yī fāngmiàn tǐng kāixīn de, lìng yī fāngmiàn yòu pà zuò bù hǎo.)
开心因此怕另一方面又一方面。(Kāixīn yīncǐ pà lìng yī fāngmiàn yòu yī fāngmiàn.)
心情不需要因为开心一方面。(Xīnqíng bù xūyào yīnwèi kāixīn yī fāngmiàn.)
turns.answer: 一方面挺开心的，另一方面又怕做不好。(Yī fāngmiàn tǐng kāixīn de, lìng yī fāngmiàn yòu pà zuò bù hǎo.)

turns.speaker: kai
turns.text: 正常啦，新岗位压力大谁都会紧张。(Zhèngcháng la, xīn gǎngwèi yālì dà shéi dōu huì jǐnzhāng.)
turns.spokenText: 正常啦，新岗位压力大谁都会紧张。

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Fill in the hedge — 'feels like'.
turns.after: 对团队的责任一下子重了很多。(Èn, wǒ ___ duì tuánduì de zérèn yīxiàzi zhòng le hěn duō.)
turns.answer: 觉得似乎

turns.speaker: kai
turns.text: 其实这种紧张说明你很在乎。(Qíshí zhè zhǒng jǐnzhāng shuōmíng nǐ hěn zàihu.)
turns.spokenText: 其实这种紧张说明你很在乎。

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Name the feeling more precisely.
options: 与其说是紧张，不如说是一种被信任的压力。(Yǔqí shuō shì jǐnzhāng, bùrú shuō shì yī zhǒng bèi xìnrèn de yālì.)
紧张因此压力所以信任不如。(Jǐnzhāng yīncǐ yālì suǒyǐ xìnrèn bùrú.)
压力不需要因为信任紧张。(Yālì bù xūyào yīnwèi xìnrèn jǐnzhāng.)
turns.answer: 与其说是紧张，不如说是一种被信任的压力。(Yǔqí shuō shì jǐnzhāng, bùrú shuō shì yī zhǒng bèi xìnrèn de yālì.)

turns.speaker: kai
turns.text: 说得很到位，这种感觉我也经历过。(Shuō de hěn dàowèi, zhè zhǒng gǎnjué wǒ yě jīnglì guò.)
turns.spokenText: 说得很到位，这种感觉我也经历过。

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Express cautious optimism.
options: 希望过一段时间，我能慢慢适应这个节奏。(Xīwàng guò yīduàn shíjiān, wǒ néng mànman shìyìng zhège jiézòu.)
我立刻马上肯定完全没问题。(Wǒ lìkè mǎshàng kěndìng wánquán méi wèntí.)
适应不需要因为慢慢节奏。(Shìyìng bù xūyào yīnwèi mànman jiézòu.)
turns.answer: 希望过一段时间，我能慢慢适应这个节奏。(Xīwàng guò yīduàn shíjiān, wǒ néng mànman shìyìng zhège jiézòu.)

turns.speaker: kai
turns.text: 你一定可以的，有需要随时找我聊。(Nǐ yīdìng kěyǐ de, yǒu xūyào suíshí zhǎo wǒ liáo.)
turns.spokenText: 你一定可以的，有需要随时找我聊。

topics.title: Defending your view
topics.description: Push back, concede a point, ask sharper questions

lessons.title: Asking sharper questions
lessons.description: 为什么, 怎么会, 难道

exercises.prompt: What does "难道" (nán dào) add to a question?
Build "Don't tell me you don't know?"
exercises.answer: 难道 你 不 知道 吗

exercises.prompt: "你怎么会这么想？" means ___
acceptableAnswers: How could you possibly think this way?

exercises.prompt: Tap the word you hear
exercises.explanation: 反对 (fǎn duì, "oppose") and 反应 (fǎn yìng, "reaction") share 反 but the second syllable is different — 对 is 4th tone, 应 is 4th tone but with a totally different vowel. Mishearing this in a debate is a real beginner trap.

exercises.prompt: What does "难道X不Y吗?" express?
options: A rhetorical question with disbelief — "surely X is Y?"
exercises.answer: A rhetorical question with disbelief — "surely X is Y?"
exercises.explanation: 难道 + statement + 吗 = pushy rhetorical question. 难道你不知道吗？ = "Don't tell me you don't know!" The expected answer is "of course I do".

exercises.prompt: Build a rhetorical question: "Don't you think this is unfair?"
exercises.answer: 难道 你 不 觉得 这 不 公平 吗

exercises.prompt: "哪里有这样的道理？" (nǎ lǐ yǒu zhè yàng de dào lǐ) is a ___ question.
exercises.explanation: 哪里 (nǎ lǐ) here is rhetorical, not asking "where". Means "how could there be such a logic?!" — a sharp pushback.

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "How could you say something like that?" (rhetorical):
exercises.explanation: 怎么能 — "how could (you)" — is the standard structure for outraged rhetorical questions.

exercises.prompt: Build "Why do you say it this way?"
exercises.answer: 你 为 什么 这么 说

exercises.prompt: the question type to its tone
"这怎么可能呢？" (zhè zěn me kě néng ne) means ___
acceptableAnswers: There's no way this is possible
exercises.explanation: 怎么可能 — incredulous protest. The 呢 at the end softens it from outrage to genuine bafflement.

exercises.prompt: Tap the rhetorical opener you hear
exercises.explanation: 难道 (nán dào) — "don't tell me that…". Don't confuse with 难怪 (no wonder), 难看 (ugly), or 难受 (uncomfortable). Listen for the 4th-tone 道.

lessons.title: Concede then push back
lessons.description: 虽然…但是 — yes, but…

exercises.prompt: What does "虽然…但是" (suī rán…dàn shì) mean?
Build "Although what you said makes sense, I still disagree"
exercises.answer: 虽然 你 说 得 有 道理 但是 我 还是 不 同意

exercises.prompt: "我承认你说得有道理" means ___
exercises.answer: I admit what you said makes sense
acceptableAnswers: I'll grant that you have a point
I admit you have a point

exercises.prompt: the concession opener to its tone
Build "Although your view has its merits, the situation is more complex than you think"
exercises.answer: 虽然 你 的 看法 有 道理 但是 情况 比 你 想 得 复杂

exercises.prompt: "不可否认" (bù kě fǒu rèn) means ___
exercises.explanation: 不可否认 — formal essay opener that concedes a fact before offering a counter-argument. "Undeniably X is true, however…"

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "You make a fair point, but I still disagree":
options: 你说得有道理，不过我还是不同意
exercises.answer: 你说得有道理，不过我还是不同意
exercises.explanation: 不过 ("however") + 还是 ("still") is the staple concession-then-pushback structure.

exercises.prompt: Build a formal pushback: "Although what you said is reasonable, we cannot ignore another important factor"
exercises.answer: 尽管 你 说 的 有 道理 但是 我们 不 能 忽视 另 一 个 重要 的 因素

exercises.prompt: "你这么说也对，但是…" means ___
exercises.answer: What you say is also right, but…
acceptableAnswers: There's truth to what you're saying, but

exercises.prompt: Pick the formal essay-style concession (not casual):
options: 诚然，A的观点有其合理性，然而…
exercises.answer: 诚然，A的观点有其合理性，然而…
exercises.explanation: 诚然 ("to be sure") + 有其合理性 ("has its rationality") + 然而 ("however") — full essay register.

exercises.prompt: Build a layered pushback: "On one hand I admit your point; on the other I think there are problems"
exercises.answer: 一 方面 我 承认 你 的 观点 另 一 方面 我 认为 也 有 问题

exercises.prompt: Tap the concession word you hear
exercises.explanation: 确实 (què shí) — "indeed/truly" — the strong-agreement concession word. Distinguish from 其实 (actually), 事实 (fact), 真实 (real).

lessons.title: Reasons & evidence
lessons.description: 因为…所以 and 由于

exercises.prompt: What's the difference between 因为 and 由于?
options: 因为 is more conversational; 由于 is more formal/written
因为 is positive; 由于 is negative
exercises.answer: 因为 is more conversational; 由于 is more formal/written

exercises.prompt: Build "Because the weather was bad, the flight was cancelled"
exercises.answer: 因为 天气 不 好 所以 航班 取消 了

exercises.prompt: "主要原因是…" (zhǔ yào yuán yīn shì) means ___
Best translation for "There are many reasons for this":
the cause-effect connector to its register

pairs.right: Stylized: the reason X is because Y

exercises.prompt: Build a stylized cause-effect: "The reason I came is because I want to help you" (之所以...是因为)
exercises.answer: 我 之所以 来 是 因为 我 想 帮 你
exercises.explanation: 之所以 X 是因为 Y — flips the order to highlight the cause: "the reason for X is Y". A B2 favorite for emphasis.

exercises.prompt: "由此可见" (yóu cǐ kě jiàn) means ___
exercises.answer: From this we can see / from this it is evident
exercises.explanation: Essay-register transition phrase before drawing a conclusion.

exercises.prompt: Pick the FORMAL written version of "because the weather was bad, the flight was cancelled":
options: 由于天气恶劣，航班被迫取消
因为天气不好，航班取消了
exercises.answer: 由于天气恶劣，航班被迫取消
exercises.explanation: 由于 + 恶劣 (severe, formal) + 被迫 (forced) is news/written register. The casual version uses 因为 + 不好 + 了.

exercises.prompt: Build "Due to limited time, we'll have to discuss this next time"
exercises.answer: 由于 时间 有限 我们 下次 再 讨论

exercises.prompt: "原因有以下几点" (yuán yīn yǒu yǐ xià jǐ diǎn) means ___
acceptableAnswers: There are several reasons listed below
The reasons include the following points
exercises.explanation: 以下几点 — "the following several points" — essay structuring phrase before listing reasons.

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "This not only affects me but also affects my family" (不仅...还):
options: 这不仅影响我，还影响我的家人
exercises.answer: 这不仅影响我，还影响我的家人

exercises.prompt: Tap the cause connector you hear
exercises.explanation: 因此 (yīn cǐ, therefore) is paired with 由于 / 因为 to mark the consequence half. Don't confuse with 因为 (because) or 由此 (from this).

lessons.title: Closing your argument
lessons.description: 总之, 总的来说 — summing up

exercises.prompt: the closing phrase
Build "In short, I think we should support this plan"
exercises.answer: 总之 我 觉得 我们 应该 支持 这个 计划

exercises.prompt: "总的来说，他是个好人" means ___
exercises.answer: Generally speaking, he's a good person
acceptableAnswers: All in all, he's a good person
Overall, he is a good person

exercises.prompt: the closing/transition phrase to its register

pairs.right: Formal essay: in summary of the above
Stylized: in a word / all things considered
Fundamentally / at the root of it

exercises.prompt: Pick the formal essay-style summary opener:
exercises.explanation: 综上所述 — "in summary of all the above" — the standard closing transition for a written argument.

exercises.prompt: Build "In short, we should think about this issue from multiple angles"
exercises.answer: 总之 我们 应该 从 多 个 角度 思考 这 个 问题

exercises.prompt: "归根结底" (guī gēn jié dǐ) means ___
exercises.answer: Fundamentally / at the root of it / when all is said and done
acceptableAnswers: When you trace it to the root
exercises.explanation: Chengyu used to introduce a final fundamental cause: 归根结底，问题在于… ("fundamentally, the issue is…").

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "In other words, we need to act":
options: 换句话说，我们需要行动
exercises.answer: 换句话说，我们需要行动

exercises.prompt: Build "Generally speaking, this plan has more advantages than disadvantages"
exercises.answer: 总 的 来 说 这 个 方案 的 优 点 多 于 缺 点
exercises.explanation: 多于 (more than) is the formal compare-pattern for written essays. Casual would be: 优点比缺点多.

exercises.prompt: "由此可见，环保势在必行" means ___
exercises.answer: From this it is clear that environmental protection is imperative
acceptableAnswers: From this we can see that environmental protection must happen
exercises.explanation: 势在必行 (shì zài bì xíng) — "the situation requires it must be done" — strong-action chengyu.

exercises.prompt: Pick the most casual conversation closer:
options: 综上所述，本人持上述观点
总而言之，鄙人深以为然
exercises.explanation: 总之就这样 — "anyway, that's how it is" — casual chat closer. The other options are formal/literary.

exercises.prompt: Tap the closing-phrase you hear
exercises.spokenText: 总 而 言 之
options: 总 而 言 之
总 的 来 说
综 上 所 述
exercises.answer: 总 而 言 之
exercises.explanation: 总而言之 (zǒng ér yán zhī) — four-syllable formal summary phrase. Listen for the rhythm; the others differ in syllable count or register.

lessons.title: Dialogue: Polite disagreement on a panel
lessons.description: Open with concession, push back, and propose a hedged middle path

exercises.prompt: On a panel about the future of remote work

turns.speaker: panelist
turns.text: 我认为远程办公已经彻底取代了传统办公室。(Wǒ rènwéi yuǎnchéng bàngōng yǐjīng chèdǐ qǔdài le chuántǒng bàngōngshì.)
turns.spokenText: 我认为远程办公已经彻底取代了传统办公室。

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Open with a polite disagreement.
options: 您的观点很有意思，不过我有一点不同看法。(Nín de guāndiǎn hěn yǒuyìsi, búguò wǒ yǒu yīdiǎn bùtóng kànfǎ.)
您说得完全错了根本不对劲。(Nín shuō de wánquán cuò le gēnběn bù duìjìn.)
观点不需要因为不同看法。(Guāndiǎn bù xūyào yīnwèi bùtóng kànfǎ.)
turns.answer: 您的观点很有意思，不过我有一点不同看法。(Nín de guāndiǎn hěn yǒuyìsi, búguò wǒ yǒu yīdiǎn bùtóng kànfǎ.)

turns.speaker: panelist
turns.text: 请讲，我们正是要听听不同的声音。(Qǐng jiǎng, wǒmen zhèng shì yào tīngting bùtóng de shēngyīn.)
turns.spokenText: 请讲，我们正是要听听不同的声音。

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Concede then push back (yes / but).
options: 远程办公确实有优势，但是面对面交流难以完全替代。(Yuǎnchéng bàngōng quèshí yǒu yōushì, dànshì miànduìmiàn jiāoliú nányǐ wánquán tìdài.)
远程因此面对面所以替代难以。(Yuǎnchéng yīncǐ miànduìmiàn suǒyǐ tìdài nányǐ.)
交流不需要因为面对面替代。(Jiāoliú bù xūyào yīnwèi miànduìmiàn tìdài.)
turns.answer: 远程办公确实有优势，但是面对面交流难以完全替代。(Yuǎnchéng bàngōng quèshí yǒu yōushì, dànshì miànduìmiàn jiāoliú nányǐ wánquán tìdài.)

turns.speaker: panelist
turns.text: 您说的有一定道理，那您建议怎么平衡？(Nín shuō de yǒu yīdìng dàolǐ, nà nín jiànyì zěnme pínghéng?)
turns.spokenText: 您说的有一定道理，那您建议怎么平衡？

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Fill in the hedge — 'perhaps'.
turns.after: 混合办公会是比较合理的方向。(___ hùnhé bàngōng huì shì bǐjiào hélǐ de fāngxiàng.)
turns.answer: 也许

turns.speaker: panelist
turns.text: 混合模式确实越来越主流了。(Hùnhé móshì quèshí yuèláiyuè zhǔliú le.)
turns.spokenText: 混合模式确实越来越主流了。

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Wrap up your point with reservation.
options: 我并不是反对远程，只是担心团队文化被弱化。(Wǒ bìng bù shì fǎnduì yuǎnchéng, zhǐshì dānxīn tuánduì wénhuà bèi ruòhuà.)
反对远程因此文化弱化所以。(Fǎnduì yuǎnchéng yīncǐ wénhuà ruòhuà suǒyǐ.)
弱化不需要因为文化担心。(Ruòhuà bù xūyào yīnwèi wénhuà dānxīn.)
turns.answer: 我并不是反对远程，只是担心团队文化被弱化。(Wǒ bìng bù shì fǎnduì yuǎnchéng, zhǐshì dānxīn tuánduì wénhuà bèi ruòhuà.)

turns.speaker: panelist
turns.text: 感谢您的补充，这正是我们要继续讨论的。(Gǎnxiè nín de bǔchōng, zhè zhèng shì wǒmen yào jìxù tǎolùn de.)
turns.spokenText: 感谢您的补充，这正是我们要继续讨论的。

topics.title: Formal communication
topics.description: Emails, speeches, signs — when 你 becomes 您

guide.intro: Mandarin makes a sharp distinction between casual and formal register. The same idea — "Could you please send me the document?" — sounds completely different in a WeChat to a friend versus an email to a client. B2 is where you start being able to switch.

sections.text: Pronouns and politeness

您 (nín) is the polite "you". You'll use it for clients, customers, elders, professors, and strangers in any service context. In groups, 您们 is rare — most speakers stay with 您 (singular) or use 各位 (everyone).
Word swaps that lift the register
Email openers and closers

rows.pinyin: Zūn jìng de Wáng lǎo shī:
rows.translation: Dear (respected) Teacher Wang,
Hello (formal).

rows.pinyin: Gǎn xiè nín de zhī chí.
rows.translation: Thank you for your support.
Wishing you well in business. (formal sign-off)
Yours sincerely / with respect.

sections.text: Casual Chinese loves 啊, 呢, 啦 — the little sentence-final particles that soften tone. Formal Chinese strips them all out. If you find yourself writing 你好啊 to a client, switch back to 您好.
Quick guide: discourse particles
Particles carry no dictionary meaning but huge emotional color. Use them in casual speech; strip them in formal writing.

items: 哎 (āi) — getting attention or expressing mild dismay: 哎，你来一下 (Hey, come here a sec)
哎呀 (āi yā) — "oh!" / "oops!" — surprise or annoyance: 哎呀，又下雨了 (Ugh, it's raining again)
啊 (a) — softens a statement or question: 你好啊 (Hi there) / 真的啊？ (Really?)
呢 (ne) — "and you?" / continuing-state marker: 你呢？ (And you?) / 他在睡觉呢 (He's sleeping [right now])
嘛 (ma) — "obviously" / "as you know": 这是常识嘛 (That's just common sense, isn't it)

rows.pinyin: Qǐng wèn, huì yì jǐ diǎn kāi shǐ?
rows.translation: May I ask, what time does the meeting start?

lessons.title: Casual vs formal
lessons.description: When to switch from 你 to 您

exercises.prompt: Which is more polite: 你 or 您?
casual to formal
Which sentence sounds appropriate in a business email?
options: 尊敬的张先生，请问您何时方便回复邮件？
exercises.answer: 尊敬的张先生，请问您何时方便回复邮件？
exercises.explanation: 尊敬的, 您, 何时方便 — every choice signals formality. Note the word order: 何时方便 (when [are you] free), not 方便何时.

exercises.prompt: casual to formal pronoun/word
Build a formal request: "May I please ask, when are you available"
exercises.answer: 请 问 您 何 时 方 便

exercises.prompt: Your boss WeChats you about a deadline. Pick the appropriate reply:
exercises.explanation: 好的 + complete sentence + 按时完成 ("finish on time") strikes the right professional-but-warm register. The others are too breezy for a workplace context.

exercises.prompt: Convert casual "现在很多人都在家工作" to formal register: "___ 许多 人 都 在 家 办公"
exercises.explanation: 现在 → 目前 is the standard register lift. 许多 (instead of 很多) and 办公 (instead of 工作) also lift the register.

exercises.prompt: the casual phrase to its formal/written equivalent
Build a formal sentence: "Currently the company is facing many challenges"
exercises.answer: 目前 公司 面临 许多 挑战

exercises.prompt: Which sentence is CASUAL?
exercises.explanation: 哎 (sentence-initial particle), 那事儿 (érhuà), 你 — every choice is informal. The others are essay/email register.

exercises.prompt: "久仰大名" (jiǔ yǎng dà míng) is used when ___
exercises.answer: Meeting someone formally for the first time — "I've long admired your name"
acceptableAnswers: Greeting someone whose reputation precedes them
Formally meeting a respected person for the first time
exercises.explanation: 久仰大名 — fixed formal greeting reserved for first introductions to someone with high standing. Don't use casually.

exercises.prompt: Tap the formal pronoun you hear
exercises.explanation: 您 (nín) and 你 (nǐ) sound nearly identical in fast speech, but 您 is reserved for politeness. Listen carefully — the nasal ending on 您 is slightly held.

lessons.title: Writing an email
lessons.description: Opener, body, sign-off

exercises.prompt: What is "尊敬的" (zūn jìng de) used for?
options: A respectful salutation in formal letters/emails
exercises.answer: A respectful salutation in formal letters/emails

exercises.prompt: Build "Could you please send me the document by tomorrow?"
exercises.answer: 麻烦 您 明天 之前 把 文件 发给 我

exercises.prompt: "感谢您的支持" means ___
acceptableAnswers: We thank you for your support

exercises.prompt: Which is a formal sign-off?
exercises.explanation: 此致敬礼 — a fixed phrase ending formal letters, no real English equivalent. "Yours sincerely" is closest.

exercises.prompt: the formal sign-off to its use
When would you write 顺祝商祺 vs 此致敬礼?
options: 顺祝商祺 = business letters; 此致敬礼 = universal formal letters
顺祝商祺 = casual; 此致敬礼 = formal
exercises.answer: 顺祝商祺 = business letters; 此致敬礼 = universal formal letters
exercises.explanation: 顺祝商祺 specifically wishes business prosperity — use it in B2B emails. 此致敬礼 is the safe default for any formal letter.

exercises.prompt: Build a formal email opener: "Dear (respected) Mr. Wang, hello"
exercises.answer: 尊敬 的 王 先生 您 好

exercises.prompt: "敬请回复" (jìng qǐng huí fù) means ___
Which sentence is a CORRECT formal request body?
options: 麻烦您把文件发一下，谢谢。
急需您的批准，请尽快回复。
Both A and B are appropriate
exercises.answer: Both A and B are appropriate
exercises.explanation: Both 麻烦您 + 谢谢 (warm-formal) and 急需 + 请尽快 (urgent-formal) work as email body lines. Different registers for different relationships.

exercises.prompt: Build the email body: "I am writing to inquire about the recent project progress"
exercises.answer: 本人 写 此 邮件 是 想 了解 最近 项目 的 进展

exercises.prompt: "如蒙回复，不胜感激" (rú méng huí fù, bù shèng gǎn jī) means ___
exercises.answer: If you would reply, I'd be deeply grateful
acceptableAnswers: I'd be most grateful for your reply
Should you reply, I'll be very grateful
exercises.explanation: 如蒙 (if granted) + 不胜感激 (overwhelmingly grateful) — pure formal-letter register. Common in academic and business correspondence.

exercises.prompt: Tap the email opener you hear
exercises.explanation: 尊敬的 (zūn jìng de) — "Respected" — is the standard salutation prefix. 尊重 means "respect" the verb, not for greetings.

lessons.title: Polite requests
lessons.description: 请, 麻烦您, 能否

exercises.prompt: the polite phrase
Build "May I ask, what time does the meeting start?"
exercises.answer: 请问 会议 几 点 开始

exercises.prompt: "能否请您介绍一下？" means ___
acceptableAnswers: Could you give a brief introduction?
Could I ask you to introduce yourself?

exercises.prompt: the polite request to its use
Build a formal request: "Please wait a moment, I will check immediately"
exercises.answer: 请 您 稍 等 我 马 上 查 一 下

exercises.prompt: A customer service rep would say:
exercises.explanation: 请您稍候 — "please wait a moment" — the standard service-industry phrase. 候 (hòu) is more formal than 等.

exercises.prompt: "如有疑问，请联系我们" means ___
exercises.answer: If you have any questions, please contact us
acceptableAnswers: Should you have questions, please reach out
If you have inquiries, please contact us
exercises.explanation: 如有 (if there are) — formal conditional. 疑问 = inquiry / question — more formal than 问题.

exercises.prompt: Pick the appropriate request to a teacher (not a friend):
exercises.explanation: Address the teacher (老师), use 能不能 (could you), soften with 看看 (have a look). The other options are too direct or grammatically incomplete for the context.

exercises.prompt: Build a polite phone request: "May I trouble you to transfer my call to manager Li?"
exercises.answer: 麻烦 您 帮 我 转接 给 李 经理

exercises.prompt: "望您理解" (wàng nín lǐ jiě) means ___
exercises.explanation: 望 = hope (formal/written equivalent of 希望). Common in formal apologies and explanations.

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "Sorry to trouble you, could you help me check this?":
options: 麻烦您了，能帮我查一下吗？
exercises.answer: 麻烦您了，能帮我查一下吗？
exercises.explanation: 麻烦您了 — "sorry to trouble you" — apology+request frame. 帮我 + V + 一下 softens the ask further.

exercises.prompt: Tap the polite verb you hear
exercises.explanation: 麻烦 (má fan) — "to trouble (someone)" — the politeness keyword. 2nd tone + neutral. Don't confuse with 麻木 (numb).

lessons.title: Speeches & openings
lessons.description: Standing in front of a room

exercises.prompt: How would a speaker typically open in front of a group?
options: 各位领导，各位来宾，大家好
exercises.answer: 各位领导，各位来宾，大家好
exercises.explanation: 各位 + role is the standard. 各位领导 = honored leaders, 各位来宾 = honored guests.

exercises.prompt: Build "First of all, thank you all for coming"
exercises.answer: 首先 感谢 大家 的 到来

exercises.prompt: "今天我想跟大家分享…" means ___
exercises.answer: Today I want to share with everyone…
acceptableAnswers: Today I'd like to share with all of you...
Today I want to share with you all

exercises.prompt: the speech-opening element to its function
Pick the appropriate speech CLOSING:
options: 谢谢大家，我的发言到此结束
exercises.answer: 谢谢大家，我的发言到此结束
exercises.explanation: Standard speech ending: thank the audience, then close with 到此结束 ("ends here"). The casual options would never appear in a formal speech.

exercises.prompt: Build a speech transition: "Next, please allow me to introduce…"
exercises.answer: 接 下 来 请 允 许 我 介绍

exercises.prompt: "在此，我谨代表…" means ___
exercises.answer: Here / on this occasion, I respectfully represent…
acceptableAnswers: On this occasion, on behalf of…
exercises.explanation: 在此 (here/on this occasion) + 谨 (respectfully) + 代表 (represent) — the standard speech opener for representing an organization.

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "On behalf of the company, I extend a warm welcome to all guests":
options: 我代表公司热烈欢迎各位来宾
exercises.answer: 我代表公司热烈欢迎各位来宾

exercises.prompt: Build "I'd like to take this opportunity to thank everyone for their support"
exercises.answer: 我 想 借 此 机 会 感 谢 大 家 的 支 持
exercises.explanation: 借此机会 — "taking this opportunity" — set phrase for transitioning into thanks during a speech.

exercises.prompt: "恭喜恭喜" (gōng xǐ gōng xǐ) is used when ___
exercises.explanation: Reduplication 恭喜恭喜 doubles the warmth. Used when meeting someone after good news (promotion, marriage, baby).

exercises.prompt: Pick the appropriate INTRODUCTION at a wedding banquet (the bride's father speaking):
options: 尊敬的各位来宾，感谢大家在百忙之中前来参加
exercises.answer: 尊敬的各位来宾，感谢大家在百忙之中前来参加
exercises.explanation: 百忙之中 ("in the midst of busy schedules") — fixed phrase acknowledging guests' time. 前来 (formal "come here to") completes the formal register.

exercises.prompt: Tap the speech opener you hear
exercises.explanation: 首先 (shǒu xiān) — "first". Speech sequencing trio: 首先, 其次, 最后.

lessons.title: Dialogue: Declining a formal invitation by phone
lessons.description: Acknowledge, decline politely, apologize, and offer a follow-up

exercises.prompt: Receiving a phone invitation to a company year-end dinner

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: 您好，我是公司活动部的张丽，邀请您下周三出席年度晚宴。(Nín hǎo, wǒ shì gōngsī huódòng bù de Zhāng Lì, yāoqǐng nín xià zhōu sān chūxí niándù wǎnyàn.)
turns.spokenText: 您好，我是公司活动部的张丽，邀请您下周三出席年度晚宴。

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Acknowledge the invitation formally.
options: 您好张女士，非常感谢贵公司的邀请。(Nín hǎo Zhāng nǚshì, fēicháng gǎnxiè guì gōngsī de yāoqǐng.)
嗨小张啊行行行知道了。(Hāi xiǎo Zhāng a xíng xíng xíng zhīdào le.)
邀请不需要因为感谢公司。(Yāoqǐng bù xūyào yīnwèi gǎnxiè gōngsī.)
turns.answer: 您好张女士，非常感谢贵公司的邀请。(Nín hǎo Zhāng nǚshì, fēicháng gǎnxiè guì gōngsī de yāoqǐng.)

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: 活动安排在晚上六点半，地点在国际饭店。(Huódòng ānpái zài wǎnshàng liù diǎn bàn, dìdiǎn zài Guójì Fàndiàn.)
turns.spokenText: 活动安排在晚上六点半，地点在国际饭店。

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Decline politely with an apology.
options: 非常抱歉，那天我已有重要安排，恐怕无法出席。(Fēicháng bàoqiàn, nà tiān wǒ yǐ yǒu zhòngyào ānpái, kǒngpà wúfǎ chūxí.)
去不了那天我有事拜拜了您。(Qù bù liǎo nà tiān wǒ yǒu shì báibái le nín.)
抱歉不需要因为安排出席。(Bàoqiàn bù xūyào yīnwèi ānpái chūxí.)
turns.answer: 非常抱歉，那天我已有重要安排，恐怕无法出席。(Fēicháng bàoqiàn, nà tiān wǒ yǐ yǒu zhòngyào ānpái, kǒngpà wúfǎ chūxí.)

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: 原来如此，那真是太可惜了。(Yuánlái rúcǐ, nà zhēn shì tài kěxí le.)
turns.spokenText: 原来如此，那真是太可惜了。

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Fill in the formal hedge — 'sorry'.
turns.after: 无法调整时间，请您谅解。(Shízài ___ wúfǎ tiáozhěng shíjiān, qǐng nín liàngjiě.)
turns.answer: 抱歉

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: 没关系，那我们之后再约时间。(Méi guānxi, nà wǒmen zhīhòu zài yuē shíjiān.)
turns.spokenText: 没关系，那我们之后再约时间。

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Offer to send a representative or follow up.
options: 我可以安排同事代为出席，并在之后亲自致谢。(Wǒ kěyǐ ānpái tóngshì dài wèi chūxí, bìng zài zhīhòu qīnzì zhìxiè.)
随便派个人去吧反正我没空。(Suíbiàn pài gè rén qù ba fǎnzhèng wǒ méi kòng.)
同事不需要因为出席致谢。(Tóngshì bù xūyào yīnwèi chūxí zhìxiè.)
turns.answer: 我可以安排同事代为出席，并在之后亲自致谢。(Wǒ kěyǐ ānpái tóngshì dài wèi chūxí, bìng zài zhīhòu qīnzì zhìxiè.)

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: 那就这样定了，感谢您的配合。(Nà jiù zhèyàng dìng le, gǎnxiè nín de pèihé.)
turns.spokenText: 那就这样定了，感谢您的配合。

topics.title: B2 review
topics.description: Stitch the patterns together: 越…越, 不仅…而且, 即使…也, 尽管, formal register

lessons.title: Pattern roundup
lessons.description: Pick the right connector

exercises.prompt: the pattern to its meaning
Pick the right connector for a real fact: "___ 下雨，他还是去跑步了"
exercises.explanation: It's a real fact (it actually rained), so 尽管 / 虽然. 即使 would be hypothetical.

exercises.prompt: Pick the right connector: "___ 下雨，我也要去" (you don't yet know if it'll rain)
Pick the right connector: "他 ___ 努力工作，___ 收入很高"
exercises.explanation: Adding two positive qualities → 不仅...而且. The other connectors don't fit "works hard AND earns well" as a parallel additive pair.

exercises.prompt: Build the connector sentence "He not only is smart, he also is hardworking" (use 不仅...而且)
exercises.answer: 他 不仅 聪明 而且 努力
exercises.explanation: 不仅 must pair with an additive (而且 / 还 / 也). It cannot pair with the contrastive 但是 — they push in opposite directions.

exercises.prompt: the connector to its required partner
"环保 ___ 来 ___ 重要" (越…越 pattern)
exercises.explanation: 环保越来越重要 — "environmental protection is more and more important". Both halves of the 越 frame are required.

exercises.prompt: Which is GRAMMATICALLY WRONG?
exercises.explanation: 越来越 already intensifies. Adding 很 doubles up. Drop one or the other.

exercises.prompt: Build "On one hand, the salary is high; on the other hand, the pressure is also great"
exercises.answer: 一方面 工资 很 高 另一方面 压力 也 很 大

exercises.prompt: "___ 人工智能 发展 得 很 快, ___ 不 能 完全 取代 人类"
exercises.explanation: Real fact (AI develops fast) + contrast (can't replace humans) → 尽管/虽然...但是 frame.

exercises.prompt: Pick the layered scenario translation: "Even if you disagree, in my view this is still the right thing to do":
options: 即使你不同意，在我看来这也是正确的事
exercises.answer: 即使你不同意，在我看来这也是正确的事
exercises.explanation: Multi-clause B2: 即使...也 (even if...still) + 在我看来 (in my view) — combining concession with opinion-stating in one breath.

exercises.prompt: Tap the connector pair you hear
exercises.spokenText: 不 仅 而 且
options: 不 仅 而 且
尽 管 但 是
虽 然 但 是
exercises.answer: 不 仅 而 且
exercises.explanation: 不仅...而且 — the additive pair. Identifying which connector pair you hear is the first step to parsing complex sentences quickly.

lessons.title: Long-sentence build
lessons.description: Compound sentences from scratch

exercises.prompt: Build "Although the work is tiring, the salary is fairly good"
exercises.answer: 虽然 工作 很 累 但是 工资 比较 不错

exercises.prompt: Build "He not only studies hard but also works very hard"
exercises.answer: 他 不仅 学习 努力 而且 工作 也 非常 努力

exercises.prompt: Build "The longer I live in China, the more I like the food here"
exercises.answer: 我 在 中国 住 得 越 久 就 越 喜欢 这里 的 食物

exercises.prompt: the connector pair to the function it expresses in a sentence

pairs.right: Hold a position despite a hypothetical
Concede a real fact, then contrast

exercises.prompt: Build "Although AI is convenient, it not only changes our jobs but also raises ethical issues" (尽管...但是 + 不仅...而且)
exercises.answer: 尽管 AI 很 方便 但是 它 不仅 改变 我们 的 工作 而且 引发 伦理 问题

exercises.prompt: Tap the compound sentence you hear
exercises.spokenText: 一 方 面 网 课 很 方 便 另 一 方 面 缺 少 互 动
options: 一 方 面 网 课 很 方 便 另 一 方 面 缺 少 互 动
网 课 很 方 便 但 是 缺 少 互 动
一 方 面 网 课 不 方 便 另 一 方 面 互 动 多
网 课 互 动 不 多 但 是 方 便
exercises.answer: 一 方 面 网 课 很 方 便 另 一 方 面 缺 少 互 动
exercises.explanation: 一方面...另一方面 has a distinctive cadence — two parallel four-syllable openers framing the two sides.

exercises.prompt: Convert single-clause to compound: "This phone is expensive AND has poor battery life". Use 不仅...而且: "这 部 手机 ___ 贵 ___ 电池 也 不 好"
Best translation for "The more you study, the more you'll find there's still much you don't know":
options: 你越学越发现还有很多不知道的
exercises.answer: 你越学越发现还有很多不知道的
exercises.explanation: 越...越 with two related clauses; 还有很多不知道的 = "there's still much I don't know".

exercises.prompt: the long compound sentence to the rhetorical move it performs

pairs.right: Concede a real fact, then contrast
Stack a second, often stronger, point

exercises.prompt: Fill the connectors: "___ 她 年纪 小 ___ 她 不仅 有 经验 ___ 有 智慧" (although...but...not only...also)
exercises.answer: 虽然 / 但是 / 而且
acceptableAnswers: 虽然 但是 而且
尽管 / 但是 / 而且
exercises.explanation: 虽然 needs 但是. 不仅 needs 而且 / 还 / 也. Two connector pairs in one layered sentence.

exercises.prompt: "越来越多的人开始关注环保" means ___
exercises.answer: More and more people are starting to pay attention to environmental protection
acceptableAnswers: An increasing number of people are paying attention to environmentalism
More people are getting concerned about the environment

exercises.prompt: Pick the correct B2 compound sentence:
options: 尽管 996 很辛苦，但是很多年轻人不仅不抗议，而且选择躺平
尽管 996 很辛苦，因为很多年轻人选择躺平
尽管 996 但是不仅躺平
exercises.answer: 尽管 996 很辛苦，但是很多年轻人不仅不抗议，而且选择躺平
exercises.explanation: Layered B2: 尽管...但是 (concession) followed by 不仅不...而且 (negative not-only-but-also) — both connector pairs correctly partnered.

lessons.title: Register switch
lessons.description: Casual or formal?

exercises.prompt: Which sentence is FORMAL?
options: 尊敬的李总，请问您何时方便？
exercises.answer: 尊敬的李总，请问您何时方便？

exercises.prompt: casual to formal again
Which is the right closing for a business email?
Your boss WeChats you about a deadline. Pick the appropriate reply:
exercises.explanation: Workplace casual-formal: 好的 + complete sentence. The other options are too casual for boss communication.

exercises.prompt: Your friend WeChats you the same question. Pick the appropriate reply:
options: 敬请放心，必将按期完成
我谨代表自己保证完成
exercises.explanation: Friend = casual register: 好嘞, 没问题. The formal options would be jarringly stiff between friends.

exercises.prompt: Convert casual to formal: "现在 没什么时间，因为 太忙了" → formal version
exercises.answer: 目前 没 有 太 多 时间 由于 工作 繁忙
exercises.explanation: 现在→目前, 因为→由于, 太忙了→工作繁忙. Each swap raises the register a level.

exercises.prompt: casual to formal sentence-pair
Casual: 你好啊！ → Formal email opener: ___
exercises.explanation: Strip the 啊 particle and swap 你 → 您. The exclamation is optional in formal writing.

exercises.prompt: Convert casual 都怪我，我来背锅 to a formal version. The blank fills: "___ 愿意 为此 承担 全部 责任"
exercises.explanation: 本人 (formal first-person) replaces casual 我 / 哥 / 我自己. 承担 (assume) replaces 背锅 (slang "take the blame"). 全部责任 = full responsibility.

exercises.prompt: Build a formal opening: "I am writing to thank you for your help"
exercises.answer: 我 写 此 信 是 想 感 谢 您 的 帮助

exercises.prompt: "敬请回复" is closer in register to: ___
exercises.explanation: 敬 (respectfully) + 请 (please) + 回复 (reply) — formal email request. Casual equivalent: 给我回个话呗 / 帮我回一下.

exercises.prompt: Tap the FORMAL connector you hear
exercises.explanation: 然而 — formal/written "however". 但是 / 可是 / 不过 are progressively more casual. Anchor delivery and essay reading favor 然而.

lessons.title: B2 mixed challenge
lessons.description: All the patterns at once

exercises.prompt: Build "Even if the pressure is great, I'll still keep going"
exercises.answer: 即使 压力 很 大 我 也 会 坚持 下去

exercises.prompt: Build "In short, environmental protection is getting more and more important"
exercises.answer: 总之 环保 越 来 越 重要

exercises.prompt: Pick the most natural translation of "I have to admit, what you said makes a lot of sense":
options: 我得承认，你说得很有道理
exercises.answer: 我得承认，你说得很有道理
exercises.explanation: 得 (děi) here = must / have to. 我得承认 is a great softener before conceding a point in an argument.

exercises.prompt: "我对这个话题非常感兴趣" means ___
exercises.answer: I am very interested in this topic
acceptableAnswers: I'm really interested in this topic
This topic interests me a lot

exercises.prompt: Build the layered B2 sentence: "Although the work is tough, I not only finished it but also learned a lot"
exercises.answer: 虽然 工作 很 难 但是 我 不仅 完成 了 而且 学 到 了 很 多

exercises.prompt: Tap the trend statement you hear
exercises.spokenText: 越 来 越 多 的 年 轻 人 选 择 躺 平
options: 越 来 越 多 的 年 轻 人 选 择 躺 平
越 来 越 多 的 年 轻 人 选 择 内 卷
越 来 越 少 年 轻 人 选 择 躺 平
年 轻 人 越 来 越 不 喜 欢 躺 平
exercises.answer: 越 来 越 多 的 年 轻 人 选 择 躺 平
exercises.explanation: Trend reporting: 越来越多的 + N + 选择 + V — the standard frame in news essays. Listen for the verb at the end (躺平 vs 内卷).

exercises.prompt: Pick the most natural translation: "In short, environmental protection isn't just the government's job; it's everyone's responsibility":
options: 总之，环保不仅是政府的事，更是每个人的责任
exercises.answer: 总之，环保不仅是政府的事，更是每个人的责任
exercises.explanation: Layered: 总之 (summarizing) + 不仅...更 (intensified additive). 更 amplifies beyond 而且.

exercises.prompt: Convert formal: "由于工作繁忙，本人尚未完成。" To casual chat with a friend: ___
exercises.answer: 因为太忙了，我还没做完
acceptableAnswers: 因为太忙了我还没做完
exercises.explanation: Casual swaps: 由于→因为, 工作繁忙→太忙了, 本人→我, 尚未→还没.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence pairs the connectors CORRECTLY?
options: 他不仅聪明，但是很努力
虽然他很累，但是没有放弃
exercises.answer: 虽然他很累，但是没有放弃
exercises.explanation: 虽然 needs 但是. 不仅 needs 而且/还/也. 尽管 pairs with 但是/还是, not 也. 即使 pairs with 也/还, not 但是.

exercises.prompt: Build "In my view, even if AI develops fast, we still cannot ignore ethics" (在我看来 + 即使...也)
exercises.answer: 在 我 看 来 即使 人工智能 发展 得 很 快 我们 也 不 能 忽视 伦理

exercises.prompt: "凡事都有两面，关键在于我们怎么看" means ___
exercises.answer: Everything has two sides; the key is how we look at it
acceptableAnswers: Every issue has two sides — the key is our perspective
There are two sides to everything; what matters is how we view it
exercises.explanation: 凡事都有两面 + 关键在于 — combined B2 essay frame for opening a balanced opinion piece.

exercises.prompt: the B2 connector frame to a sample English meaning

pairs.right: The more X, the more Y
Not only X, but also Y
The reason for X is because Y

lessons.title: Dialogue: A workplace incident — opinion and register
lessons.description: Give a hedged opinion, report hearsay, and propose a formal fix

exercises.prompt: Coworker debriefs after a colleague clashed with a client in a meeting

turns.speaker: li
turns.text: 今天会议上小王跟客户呛声了，你怎么看？(Jīntiān huìyì shàng Xiǎo Wáng gēn kèhù qiāngshēng le, nǐ zěnme kàn?)

turns.answer: 虽然他出发点是好的，但是说话方式确实欠妥。(Suīrán tā chūfādiǎn shì hǎo de, dànshì shuōhuà fāngshì quèshí qiàn tuǒ.)

让小王赶紧去客户那儿磕个头算了。(Ràng Xiǎo Wáng gǎnjǐn qù kèhù nàr kē gè tóu suànle.)
邮件不需要因为道歉客户。(Yóujiàn bù xūyào yīnwèi dàoqiàn kèhù.)
turns.answer: 我们或许应该让小王亲自给客户写封邮件道歉。(Wǒmen huòxǔ yīnggāi ràng Xiǎo Wáng qīnzì gěi kèhù xiě fēng yóujiàn dàoqiàn.)

教训不需要因此追究责任。(Jiàoxùn bù xūyào yīncǐ zhuījiū zérèn.)
责任因此教训不如追究。(Zérèn yīncǐ jiàoxùn bùrú zhuījiū.)
turns.answer: 与其追究责任，不如把它当成一次教训。(Yǔqí zhuījiū zérèn, bùrú bǎ tā dàngchéng yī cì jiàoxùn.)

turns.speaker: li
turns.text: 说得对，希望他以后能注意分寸。(Shuō de duì, xīwàng tā yǐhòu néng zhùyì fēncùn.)
turns.spokenText: 说得对，希望他以后能注意分寸。

levels.name: C1 — Advanced
levels.description: Operate in Mandarin for business, academic, and journalistic contexts. Argue a position, structure formal discourse, and use 成语 with confidence.

topics.title: Business Chinese
topics.description: Meetings, negotiation, and formal correspondence

guide.intro: Business Mandarin lives in a register far above everyday speech. The same idea you'd say with 因为...所以 over coffee gets dressed up with 鉴于... 因此 in a meeting. Three habits define the register: connectives that tie clauses together, nominalized topics with 至于, and a default to 您 / 贵 honorifics.

sections.text: Formal causal connectives

Casual Chinese uses 因为 X 所以 Y. In formal writing and meetings, you upgrade to 鉴于 X，因此 Y ("in view of X, therefore Y") or 由于 X，故 Y ("owing to X, hence Y"). 因此 and 故 are interchangeable for "therefore", but 故 sounds bookish.

rows.source: 鉴于市场环境的变化，我们因此调整了战略。
rows.pinyin: Jiànyú shìchǎng huánjìng de biànhuà, wǒmen yīncǐ tiáozhěng le zhànlüè.
rows.translation: In view of market changes, we have therefore adjusted our strategy.

rows.source: 由于成本上升，公司因此决定提价。
rows.pinyin: Yóuyú chéngběn shàngshēng, gōngsī yīncǐ juédìng tíjià.
rows.translation: Owing to rising costs, the company has accordingly decided to raise prices.

rows.source: 因为成本上升，所以我们涨价了。
rows.pinyin: Yīnwèi chéngběn shàngshēng, suǒyǐ wǒmen zhǎngjià le.
rows.translation: Because costs rose, we raised prices. (casual)

sections.text: 然而 vs 但是 — "however"
但是 works in any register. 然而 is the formal cousin you reach for in reports, op-eds, and presentations. 不过 sits in between — written Chinese friendly but not stiff.

rows: Strong contrast in essays, news, reports.

sections.text: 至于 — topic shift

至于 X ("as for X") moves the spotlight to a new sub-topic and is heavily used in structured talks. The phrase always introduces a fresh clause and is followed by a comma. Think of it as the spoken equivalent of a slide transition.

rows.source: 营收方面我们超出预期。至于成本，仍需进一步控制。
rows.pinyin: Yíngshōu fāngmiàn wǒmen chāochū yùqī. Zhìyú chéngběn, réng xū jìnyībù kòngzhì.
rows.translation: On revenue we exceeded expectations. As for costs, they still need to be controlled further.

rows.source: 至于您提到的合作方式，我们下周再深入讨论。
rows.pinyin: Zhìyú nín tídào de hézuò fāngshì, wǒmen xiàzhōu zài shēnrù tǎolùn.
rows.translation: As for the form of cooperation you mentioned, let us discuss it in depth next week.

sections.text: 贵 — honorific prefix

贵 ("honored") attaches to nouns referring to the other party's affiliations: 贵公司 (your company), 贵校 (your school), 贵姓 (your honored surname). Use 贵 anywhere a respectful tone is owed; in return, refer to your own side with the humble 敝 (敝公司 "my humble company") or simply 我方 ("our side").
Mixing registers will make you sound off. Once you open a meeting with 贵公司, stay in formal mode: keep using 您, swap 但是 for 然而, and lean on 至于 for transitions.

lessons.title: Opening a meeting
lessons.description: Greet, thank, and frame the agenda

exercises.prompt: What does "承蒙贵公司的支持" (chéng méng guì gōngsī de zhīchí) mean?
exercises.explanation: 承蒙 is a formal "thanks to / kindly receiving"; 贵公司 is the honorific "your company".

exercises.prompt: Build "Today's agenda mainly covers three items"
exercises.answer: 今天 的 议程 主要 包括 三 项 内容

exercises.prompt: the formal opener to its function

pairs.right: Thanks for taking time to attend

pairs.left: 请允许我做个简单的介绍
pairs.right: Allow me to make a brief introduction
Let's begin with item one on the agenda
I hope we can reach consensus today

exercises.prompt: "贵公司" is the formal way to say ___
exercises.explanation: The 贵 honorific elevates references to the other party.

exercises.prompt: Spot the register mismatch — which sentence sounds wrong because a casual word slipped into a formal opener?
options: 感谢各位拨冗出席今天的会议
感谢大家抽空来开个会
感谢各位拨冗出席这次破会
尊敬的各位嘉宾，欢迎莅临
exercises.answer: 感谢各位拨冗出席这次破会
exercises.explanation: 拨冗出席 is formal; 破会 ("crap meeting") is dismissive slang. The casual second option is internally consistent; the third option mixes a stiff opener with a slur. The other two stay in register.

exercises.prompt: the meeting role to its Chinese title
Build "Allow me on behalf of the company to extend a warm welcome to everyone"
exercises.answer: 请 允许 我 代表 公司 对 各位 表示 热烈 的 欢迎

exercises.prompt: Tap the honorific pronoun you hear
exercises.explanation: 您 (formal) versus 你 (neutral) is the C1 register dial. 贵姓 ("honored surname") only pairs with 您.

exercises.prompt: Which transition best opens the agenda after greetings?
options: 下面我们进入正式议程
exercises.answer: 下面我们进入正式议程
exercises.explanation: 进入正式议程 ("enter the formal agenda") is the standard transition. The others either drop register or sound dictatorial.

exercises.prompt: Complete the formal opener: "今天的会议主要 ___ 三项议程" (mainly covers)
exercises.explanation: 包括 ("includes") is the neutral choice. 涉及 ("touches on") and 围绕 ("revolves around") also work depending on emphasis.

exercises.prompt: Build "In view of the tight schedule today, please make your remarks concise"
exercises.answer: 鉴于 今天 时间 紧迫 ， 请 各位 发言 尽量 简短

exercises.prompt: Which is the closest near-synonym distinction at C1?
options: 我认为 (current view) ≠ 我以为 (mistaken prior view)
exercises.answer: 我认为 (current view) ≠ 我以为 (mistaken prior view)
exercises.explanation: 我以为 implies the speaker has been corrected. 我认为 is a current claim. Mishearing one for the other inverts the message.

lessons.title: Negotiation language
lessons.description: Soften, push back, propose terms

exercises.prompt: Which phrase most diplomatically rejects a proposal?
options: 恐怕这个方案我们难以接受
exercises.answer: 恐怕这个方案我们难以接受
exercises.explanation: 恐怕 ("I'm afraid") + 难以接受 ("hard to accept") softens the rejection while staying firm.

exercises.prompt: Build "On the price issue we hope you can reconsider"
exercises.answer: 在 价格 问题 上 我们 希望 贵方 可以 再 考虑 一下

exercises.prompt: What does "双方各让一步" (shuāngfāng gè ràng yí bù) suggest?
exercises.explanation: Literally "both sides each yield one step" — classic negotiation phrasing for a compromise.

exercises.prompt: "我们的底线" (wǒmen de dǐ xiàn) means "our ___"
exercises.explanation: 底线 = bottom line, the lowest acceptable terms.

exercises.prompt: the negotiation move to its Chinese phrase
Pick the supplier-negotiation phrasing that signals a willingness to compromise without giving up leverage:
options: 在数量上我们可以让步，但单价必须维持
你们说什么我们都同意
这个条件我们绝对不接受，不用谈了
exercises.answer: 在数量上我们可以让步，但单价必须维持
exercises.explanation: Concede on volume, hold the unit price — classic negotiation move expressed in formal Mandarin.

exercises.prompt: Build "In view of the long-term partnership, we are willing to make appropriate concessions on the payment terms"
exercises.answer: 鉴于 长期 合作 关系 ， 我方 愿意 在 付款 条件 上 做出 适当 让步

exercises.prompt: Tap the formality marker you hear in the negotiation reply
exercises.spokenText: 目前我们希望贵方再考虑一下
options: 目前我们希望贵方再考虑一下
现在我们想你们再考虑一下
目前我们希望你方再考虑一下
exercises.answer: 目前我们希望贵方再考虑一下
exercises.explanation: 目前 (formal "currently") + 希望 (formal "hope") + 贵方 ("your honorable side") all align in register. Listening for 现在/目前 and 你方/贵方 catches register at speed.

exercises.prompt: What does "达成共识" (dá chéng gòng shí) mean?
exercises.explanation: 达成 ("reach") + 共识 ("shared understanding") — standard meeting outcome language.

exercises.prompt: Complete: "双方在主要条款上已经 ___ 共识" (have reached)
exercises.explanation: 达成共识 / 达成协议 — fixed business collocations.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence transforms casual "我觉得这个价格太贵了" into formal supplier-negotiation register?
options: 我方认为该报价偏高，希望贵方能予以调整
你这个价格也太贵了吧
exercises.answer: 我方认为该报价偏高，希望贵方能予以调整
exercises.explanation: 我方 / 该报价 / 予以调整 are all formal upgrades of 我们/这个价格/改一下.

lessons.title: Formal email & letters
lessons.description: Salutations, body, and sign-offs

exercises.prompt: the email element to its position

pairs.left: 兹就贵公司提出的方案，回复如下

exercises.prompt: What does "兹" (zī) mean in formal email?
exercises.explanation: 兹 is a classical-style word still used in formal correspondence to mean "hereby".

exercises.prompt: Build "Attached please find the contract draft, please kindly review"
exercises.answer: 附件 是 合同 草稿 敬请 查阅

exercises.prompt: "此致 敬礼" closes a Chinese formal letter, equivalent to ___
exercises.explanation: Standard formal sign-off; literally "to here, salute".

exercises.prompt: What does "敬请查阅" mean in a formal email?
exercises.explanation: 敬请 ("respectfully request") + 查阅 ("check / read") — fixed honorific request.

exercises.prompt: Spot the register mismatch in this formal email body:
options: 兹就贵公司提出的方案，我方回复如下
兹就贵公司的提案，我方答复如下
兹就你们那个方案，我方回复如下
关于贵公司的方案，我方答复如下
exercises.answer: 兹就你们那个方案，我方回复如下
exercises.explanation: 兹/我方 are classical-register formal; 你们那个方案 is colloquial pointing language. Mixing them sounds jarring; the other three keep register internally consistent.

exercises.prompt: Build the formal email line "In view of the contract you provided, we hereby reply as follows"
exercises.answer: 鉴于 贵方 提供 的 合同 ， 兹 回复 如下

exercises.prompt: the email element to its Chinese standard line

pairs.right: 主题：关于合同条款的回复
兹就贵公司提出的方案，回复如下

exercises.prompt: Tap the salutation register you hear
exercises.explanation: 尊敬的 + 您 = consistently formal. The 你/您 swap downgrades register; 亲爱的 sounds personal; 啊 is colloquial.

exercises.prompt: Convert casual "麻烦你看一下" into formal email language: "敬请 ___"
exercises.explanation: 敬请查阅/审阅/过目 are interchangeable formal requests for the recipient to read.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence appropriately confirms attachment delivery in formal register?
options: 附件中是合同草稿，请贵方审阅
我把合同贴在下面了，看一下
exercises.answer: 附件中是合同草稿，请贵方审阅
exercises.explanation: 附件中 + 贵方 + 审阅 = formal alignment. The other three slide into casual or commanding tone.

lessons.title: Discussing performance
lessons.description: Numbers, growth, projections

exercises.prompt: "营收同比增长百分之十五" means revenue grew ___
exercises.explanation: 同比 specifically means "compared with the same period last year". 环比 = quarter-over-quarter / period-over-period.

exercises.prompt: Build "This quarter's profit is significantly higher than expected"
exercises.answer: 本 季度 的 利润 远 高于 预期

exercises.prompt: the term to its meaning
"扭亏为盈" describes a company turning ___
exercises.explanation: 扭亏为盈 (niǔ kuī wéi yíng) — a fixed business expression for becoming profitable.

exercises.prompt: Tap the comparison metric you hear
exercises.explanation: 同比 (year-over-year) and 环比 (period-over-period) sound and look alike but mean different things. Train your ear to hear 同 vs 环.

exercises.prompt: the KPI term to its meaning
What does "营收同比增长百分之十五，环比下降百分之三" mean?
options: Revenue rose 15% year-over-year but fell 3% quarter-over-quarter
Revenue rose 15% this quarter and 3% next quarter
exercises.answer: Revenue rose 15% year-over-year but fell 3% quarter-over-quarter
exercises.explanation: Mixed-direction comparisons in earnings are routine. 同比 = vs same period last year; 环比 = vs prior period.

exercises.prompt: Build "In view of falling profit margin, the company is therefore strengthening cost control"
exercises.answer: 鉴于 利润率 下降 ， 公司 因此 加强 成本 控制

exercises.prompt: Tap the figure you hear
exercises.explanation: C1 listening trains your ear for big numbers. 十亿 = 1 billion; 一亿 = 100 million; 十万 = 100,000.

exercises.prompt: Complete: "本季度净利润 ___ 上季度增长百分之八" (compared with last quarter)
exercises.explanation: 较 X 增长 Y is the formal earnings-report frame. 比 also works in neutral register.

exercises.prompt: Which forecast hedge is the most cautious?
options: 我们一定超额完成目标
我们应该可以完成目标
exercises.explanation: 有望 ("there is hope") is the standard analyst-grade hedge. 一定 / 必将 are over-confident; 应该可以 is conversational.

exercises.prompt: the financial trend phrase to its meaning

lessons.title: Closing & follow-up
lessons.description: Wrapping the meeting and confirming next steps

exercises.prompt: Build "Thank you all for your valuable input"
exercises.answer: 感谢 各位 提出 的 宝贵 意见

exercises.prompt: Which best translates "We'll follow up by email next week"?
options: 下周我们再用邮件跟进
exercises.answer: 下周我们再用邮件跟进
exercises.explanation: 跟进 ("follow up") is a borrowed business term in modern Chinese.

exercises.prompt: the closing phrase to its meaning

pairs.right: Looking forward to working together again

exercises.prompt: What does "会议纪要将于会后一周内发出" mean?

The meeting will end within a week
Minutes are due before the meeting
The meeting will be held weekly

exercises.prompt: the contract-signing phrase
Build "Both parties confirm the contract will take effect on the date of signing"
exercises.answer: 双方 确认 合同 自 签署 之日 起 生效

exercises.prompt: Which closing line best reflects "a successful, win-win meeting"?
options: 今天的会议非常圆满，期待与贵方达成长期合作
今天就到这吧，下次再说

exercises.explanation: 圆满 ("perfectly concluded") + 期待 + 长期合作 = polished closing register.

exercises.prompt: Tap the follow-up plan you hear
exercises.spokenText: 下周三我们以邮件形式跟进

下周二我们以邮件形式跟进
下周三我们以电话形式跟进
下周三我们以会议形式跟进
exercises.answer: 下周三我们以邮件形式跟进

exercises.prompt: Complete the formal close: "如有任何疑问，请随时与我方 ___" (contact)
exercises.explanation: 联系 (contact) and 沟通 (communicate) both work; 联系 is more standard.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence transforms casual "我们之后再说吧" into proper meeting close-out?
options: 至于剩余事项，我们将在下次会议中进一步讨论
exercises.answer: 至于剩余事项，我们将在下次会议中进一步讨论
exercises.explanation: 至于 fronts a sub-topic; 剩余事项 / 进一步讨论 are formal upgrades of 剩下的事 / 再说.

turns.speaker: chair

turns.spokenText: 顾虑的核心是什么？我们能否在条款上有所让步

turns.answer: 另一方面

我下周会写得很清楚的啦。
