topics.title: Academic discourse
topics.description: Lectures, papers, and presenting research

guide.intro: Academic Chinese is dense, nominalized, and emphasis-heavy. Two structures dominate: 是...的 to spotlight one component of an established fact, and nominalization with 的 / 来说 / 而言 to package whole clauses as topics. Master these and your writing instantly sounds academic.

sections.text: 是...的 — emphasis on a known event

When the listener already knows the action happened and you want to highlight when, where, how, or who did it, wrap that element in 是...的. The 是 sits before the highlighted phrase; 的 closes the sentence.

rows.translation: He came. (neutral statement)
It was yesterday that he came. (when)

rows.pinyin: Tā shì cóng Běijīng lái de.
rows.translation: It is from Beijing that he came. (where)

rows.pinyin: Zhè běn shū shì èr líng yī bā nián chūbǎn de.
rows.translation: This book was published in 2018. (focus on the year)

sections.text: 是...的 only works for events the listener already accepts as fact. If you're announcing fresh news, use 了 instead — 是...的 would sound oddly defensive.
Nominalization with 的话 / 来说 / 而言

Academic writing turns clauses into topic NPs. 对 X 来说 / 对 X 而言 means "as far as X is concerned". 就 X 而言 raises the formality further. These structures let you front a scoped premise before delivering an argument.

rows.source: 对发展中国家来说，气候变化是巨大的挑战。
rows.pinyin: Duì fāzhǎn zhōng guójiā lái shuō, qìhòu biànhuà shì jùdà de tiǎozhàn.
rows.translation: For developing countries, climate change is a huge challenge.

rows.source: 就经济效益而言，这个方案最为合理。
rows.pinyin: Jiù jīngjì xiàoyì ér yán, zhège fāng'àn zuì wéi hélǐ.
rows.translation: In terms of economic benefit, this plan is the most reasonable.

rows.source: 如果按这个标准的话，我们都不合格。
rows.pinyin: Rúguǒ àn zhège biāozhǔn de huà, wǒmen dōu bù hégé.
rows.translation: If we go by this standard, none of us qualify.

sections.text: Hedging your claims
Academic Chinese hedges constantly. 似乎 (it seems), 可能 (possibly), 在一定程度上 (to a certain extent), and 总的来说 (generally speaking) are the four pillars. Stack them to soften strong claims.
Citing and quoting

rows.translation: According to Professor Wang's research…
As scholars have pointed out…

rows.source: 数据显示，过去十年间增长了百分之四十。
rows.pinyin: Shùjù xiǎnshì, guòqù shí nián jiān zēngzhǎng le bǎi fēn zhī sìshí.
rows.translation: The data show that over the past decade it grew by 40%.

lessons.title: 是...的 emphasis
lessons.description: Highlight when, where, or how something happened

exercises.prompt: What does "她是去年从英国回来的" emphasize?
options: When and where she returned from
exercises.answer: When and where she returned from
exercises.explanation: 是...的 highlights the time (去年) and origin (从英国); the listener already knows she returned.

exercises.prompt: Build "This theory was first proposed by Einstein"
exercises.answer: 这个 理论 是 爱因斯坦 最早 提出 的

exercises.prompt: Pick the correct emphasis sentence for "It was in 1949 that the People's Republic was founded."
options: 中华人民共和国是1949年成立的
中华人民共和国1949年成立了
中华人民共和国成立1949年
中华人民共和国是1949年成立
exercises.answer: 中华人民共和国是1949年成立的
exercises.explanation: 是...的 frames 1949 as the focused year; the other options either drop 是, drop 的, or scramble the word order.

exercises.prompt: Pick the correct word: "这篇论文 ___ 王教授写的" (focus: who wrote it)
exercises.explanation: 是...的 fronts "by Professor Wang" as the focus. 被 would create a passive but mismatch with 的; 把 needs a disposed object after it; 在 marks location, not agent focus.

exercises.prompt: Build "This phenomenon was first discovered in the 19th century"
exercises.answer: 这 一 现象 是 在 十九 世纪 首次 被 发现 的

exercises.prompt: Convert casual "她昨天回来了" into 是...的 emphasis (focus on the time):
exercises.explanation: 是 sits before the highlighted time; 的 closes the sentence. The other options break the frame.

exercises.prompt: the 是...的 sentence to what it emphasizes
Complete with the missing 的 closer: "该理论是上世纪七十年代提出 ___"
exercises.explanation: 是...的 always closes with 的 — a common omission error.

exercises.prompt: Tap the focus you hear
exercises.explanation: 美 vs 英 is a one-tone listening swap. 是...的 vs 了 changes whether the sentence is emphasis-frame or fresh report.

exercises.prompt: Build the formal academic line "This finding was published in Nature last year"
exercises.answer: 这 一 发现 是 去年 在 《 自然 》 杂志 上 发表 的

exercises.prompt: Which version is correct emphasis for "It was Einstein who first proposed this theory"?
options: 这一理论是爱因斯坦最早提出的
爱因斯坦最早提出这一理论了
这一理论由爱因斯坦提出过
exercises.answer: 这一理论是爱因斯坦最早提出的
exercises.explanation: 是...的 frames 爱因斯坦 + 最早 as the focus. The other forms either drop 是/的 or scramble word order.

lessons.title: Topic framing — 对...来说
lessons.description: Scope an argument to a population or angle

exercises.prompt: Build "For young people, housing prices are unbearable"
exercises.answer: 对 年轻人 来说 ， 房价 已经 难以 承受

exercises.prompt: Which is most formal?
exercises.explanation: 对...而言 is the formal academic version of 对...来说; both go further than 我觉得.

exercises.prompt: the framing phrase

pairs.right: As far as students are concerned

exercises.prompt: "从长远来看" (cóng cháng yuǎn lái kàn) means "in the ___ run"
Build "In terms of economic efficiency, this plan is the most reasonable"
exercises.answer: 就 经济 效益 而言 ， 这个 方案 最为 合理

exercises.prompt: What does "就这一问题而言，学界尚未达成共识" mean?
options: On this question, academia has not yet reached consensus
exercises.answer: On this question, academia has not yet reached consensus
exercises.explanation: 就...而言 frames the topic; 尚未 ("not yet") is the formal version of 还没.

exercises.prompt: the topic-framing phrase to its register

pairs.right: Neutral, common in speech and writing

exercises.prompt: Complete the formal academic frame: "___ 发展中国家 而言，气候变化是巨大的挑战"
exercises.explanation: 对...而言 / 就...而言 are both correct; 对 is more common.

exercises.prompt: Spot the register mismatch:
options: 对学生而言，考试压力非常大
对学生来说，考试压力非常大
学生嘛，考试压力对他们而言非常大
就学生而言，考试压力非常大
exercises.answer: 学生嘛，考试压力对他们而言非常大
exercises.explanation: 嘛 is colloquial filler; 而言 is formal. Mixing them sounds jarring. The other three are register-internally consistent.

exercises.prompt: Build "In the long run, education investment will yield enormous returns"
exercises.answer: 从 长远 来看 ， 教育 投入 将 带来 巨大 回报

exercises.prompt: Tap the framing phrase you hear
exercises.spokenText: 对年轻人而言房价已经难以承受
options: 对年轻人而言房价已经难以承受
对年轻人来说房价已经难以承受
对老年人而言房价已经难以承受
对年轻人而言房价已经可以承受
exercises.answer: 对年轻人而言房价已经难以承受
exercises.explanation: Listening at C1: 而言/来说 is register; 年轻人/老年人 is the topic; 难以/可以 inverts polarity.

lessons.title: Citing & paraphrasing
lessons.description: Bring sources into your argument

exercises.prompt: the citation phrase
Build "The data show that population is rising year by year"
exercises.answer: 数据 表明 ， 人口 正在 逐年 上升

exercises.prompt: What does "众所周知" (zhòng suǒ zhōu zhī) mean?
options: It is well known to all
exercises.answer: It is well known to all
exercises.explanation: Literally "what the masses all know" — a fixed academic opener.

exercises.prompt: "研究表明" (yán jiū biǎo míng) means "research ___"
Tap the connective you hear
exercises.spokenText: 因此我们得出以下结论
options: 因此我们得出以下结论
由此我们得出以下结论
因为我们得出以下结论
于是我们得出以下结论
exercises.answer: 因此我们得出以下结论
exercises.explanation: 因此 ("therefore") and 由此 ("from this") both link cause to result, but 因此 fronts the conclusion while 由此 fronts the inference path. Train your ear to catch the difference.

exercises.prompt: the citation style to its function
Pick the most academic phrasing for "according to the latest research":
exercises.explanation: 根据 ("based on") + 研究 + neutral nominalization is the academic standard. The others are casual or hedged.

exercises.prompt: Build "As Professor Wang has pointed out, this view warrants further investigation"
exercises.answer: 正如 王 教授 所 指出 的 ， 这 一 观点 值得 进一步 研究

exercises.prompt: Peer-review hedge: "该论文 ___ 一定的创新性，但论证仍可加强" (has a certain degree of)
exercises.explanation: 具有/具备一定的 X 是 standard peer-review hedge — you grant a degree without overstating.

exercises.prompt: What does "该研究为后续工作奠定了基础" mean?
options: This research lays the foundation for follow-up work
exercises.answer: This research lays the foundation for follow-up work
exercises.explanation: 奠定基础 = lay the foundation — fixed academic praise.

exercises.prompt: Build "The data show that over the past decade urbanization has accelerated significantly"
exercises.answer: 数据 表明 ， 过去 十年 间 城市化 进程 显著 加快

lessons.title: Hedging & qualifying
lessons.description: Soften claims like a careful scholar

exercises.prompt: Which phrase hedges a generalization the most?
exercises.explanation: 在一定程度上 ("to a certain extent") signals a partial / qualified claim.

exercises.prompt: Build "This phenomenon seems to be related to climate change"
exercises.answer: 这 一 现象 似乎 与 气候 变化 有关

exercises.prompt: the hedge to its function
"据说" (jù shuō) introduces a claim attributed to others — "___" in English
Which sentence is the most cautious academic claim?
options: 结果绝对证明气候变化加速
结果在一定程度上表明气候变化可能加速
结果表明气候变化加速
结果说明气候变化必然加速
exercises.answer: 结果在一定程度上表明气候变化可能加速
exercises.explanation: 在一定程度上 + 可能 stacks two hedges. 绝对/必然/必将 over-claim; 表明 alone is moderate.

exercises.prompt: Build "Generally speaking, this approach has some validity"
exercises.answer: 总的 来说 ， 这种 方法 在 一定 程度 上 是 有效 的

exercises.prompt: the hedge to its strength
Pick the near-synonym distinction:
options: 我深信 (firm conviction) > 我认为 (current view) > 我以为 (mistaken prior)
exercises.answer: 我深信 (firm conviction) > 我认为 (current view) > 我以为 (mistaken prior)
exercises.explanation: Strength gradient: 我深信 (deeply believe) > 我坚信 ≈ 我认为 > 我觉得 > 我以为 (was mistaken). Mishearing flips the message.

exercises.prompt: Tap the hedged claim you hear
exercises.spokenText: 这一现象似乎与气候变化有关
options: 这一现象似乎与气候变化有关
这一现象肯定与气候变化有关
这一现象似乎与气候变化无关
这一现象一定与气候变化有关
exercises.answer: 这一现象似乎与气候变化有关
exercises.explanation: 似乎/肯定/一定 sit at very different hedge levels. 有关/无关 inverts polarity.

exercises.prompt: Build "To a certain extent, this view has its rationale, but it still needs further verification"
exercises.answer: 在 一定 程度 上 ， 这 一 观点 有 其 道理 ， 但 仍 需 进一步 验证

exercises.prompt: Soften the strong claim: "该方案绝对可行" → "该方案 ___ 可行" (in a certain way)
exercises.explanation: 或许/可能/似乎/在一定程度上 all soften the assertion.

lessons.title: Presenting research
lessons.description: Open, signpost, and conclude a talk

exercises.prompt: Build "Today I want to discuss three main findings"
exercises.answer: 今天 我 想 讨论 三 个 主要 发现

exercises.prompt: the signpost to its function
What does "综上所述" (zōng shàng suǒ shù) mean?
exercises.explanation: Standard academic transition leading into the conclusion section.

exercises.prompt: "谢谢大家，欢迎提问" closes a talk and means "thank you all, ___ for questions"
the thesis-section name to its function
Which line best opens an academic talk?
options: 今天我想跟大家分享我们最近的研究成果
我说啊，最近做了点东西
听好了，今天讲我的论文
exercises.answer: 今天我想跟大家分享我们最近的研究成果
exercises.explanation: 分享研究成果 + 跟大家 = warm but academic. The other three drift toward casual or hostile.

exercises.prompt: Build "To summarize the above, our research has three main findings"
exercises.answer: 综上 所述 ， 我们 的 研究 有 三 个 主要 发现

exercises.prompt: Tap the closing transition you hear
exercises.spokenText: 综上所述这一假设得到验证
options: 综上所述这一假设得到验证
综上所述这一假设遭到否定
总而言之这一假设得到验证
总的来说这一假设得到验证
exercises.answer: 综上所述这一假设得到验证
exercises.explanation: 综上所述/总而言之/总的来说 are register-graded summarizers. 得到验证 / 遭到否定 inverts the conclusion.

exercises.prompt: Pick the correct signpost order in a talk:
exercises.explanation: 首先 → 其次 → 再次 (optional) → 最后 is the canonical sequence.

exercises.prompt: Complete: "由此 ___，环境保护至关重要" (we can see / it follows that)
exercises.explanation: 由此可见 fronts a concluding inference. 不难看出 is a near-synonym.

exercises.prompt: Build "Thank you for listening, your questions and feedback are most welcome"
exercises.answer: 感谢 各位 的 聆听 ， 欢迎 大家 提问 与 指正

lessons.title: 把…当作 / 视…为 — "regard X as Y"
lessons.description: Frame an entity as something else for analysis

exercises.prompt: What does "我们把语言当作一种工具" mean?
options: We treat language as a tool
exercises.answer: We treat language as a tool
exercises.explanation: 把 X 当作 Y = "take X to be Y / regard X as Y". A core academic framing.

exercises.prompt: Build "This article regards education as the foundation of social mobility"
exercises.answer: 这 篇 文章 把 教育 视为 社会 流动 的 基础

exercises.prompt: the framing pattern to its register

pairs.right: Neutral, common in speech and writing

exercises.prompt: Complete the formal version: "我们 ___ 数据 视 ___ 决策的依据" (regard data as the basis for decisions)
exercises.explanation: 把/将 X 视为 Y is the formal academic frame; 把 X 当作 Y is the neutral cousin.

exercises.prompt: Build "This article regards the development of artificial intelligence as the central question of our era"
exercises.answer: 本文 将 人工 智能 的 发展 视为 这 一 时代 的 核心 问题

exercises.prompt: Spot the register mismatch:
options: 本文将语言视为一种社会工具
我们把语言看成一种工具
我们将语言看成一种工具呗
本研究将语言视为一种交际工具
exercises.answer: 我们将语言看成一种工具呗
exercises.explanation: 将 + 视/看成 lean formal; 呗 is a casual sentence-final particle. The other three keep register internally consistent.

exercises.prompt: Tap the framing you hear
exercises.spokenText: 我们将教育视为社会流动的基础
options: 我们将教育视为社会流动的基础
我们把教育当作社会流动的基础
我们把教育看成社会流动的基础
我们将教育看成社会流动的基础
exercises.answer: 我们将教育视为社会流动的基础
exercises.explanation: 将...视为 is the most formal academic register; 把...当作 is neutral; 看成 is casual.

exercises.prompt: Convert casual "我们把它当成宝" into academic register: "我们 ___ 视 ___ 珍宝"
What does "该研究将文化视为一种动态结构" mean?
options: This study regards culture as a dynamic structure
exercises.answer: This study regards culture as a dynamic structure
exercises.explanation: 将 X 视为 Y = treat X as Y. 动态结构 = dynamic structure.

exercises.prompt: Build "Some scholars regard climate change as the greatest challenge of the 21st century"
exercises.answer: 一些 学者 将 气候 变化 视为 二十 一 世纪 最 大 的 挑战

lessons.title: 由此可见 / 不难看出 — drawing inferences
lessons.description: Lead the reader to your conclusion

exercises.prompt: What does "由此可见" (yóu cǐ kě jiàn) signal in academic writing?
options: From this we can see / it follows that
exercises.answer: From this we can see / it follows that
exercises.explanation: 由此可见 hands the reader a conclusion drawn from the evidence just presented.

exercises.prompt: the inference phrase

pairs.right: From this it can be seen
It is not hard to see

exercises.prompt: Build "It is not hard to see that this trend will continue"
exercises.answer: 不难 看出 ， 这 一 趋势 将 持续

exercises.prompt: Complete: "___ ，教育对经济发展至关重要" (from this it can be seen that...)
exercises.explanation: 由此可见 fronts a concluding inference.

exercises.prompt: Build "From this it can be seen that the demographic trend has profoundly affected the economy"

topics.title: Art & literature
topics.description: Read poems, discuss films, appreciate calligraphy

guide.intro: Classical Chinese threads through modern writing in three little words: 之, 其, 所. They look intimidating but they're not new grammar — they're compressed forms of structures you already know. Recognize them and most literary and academic Chinese opens up.

sections.text: 之 — the literary 的
之 (zhī) is what 的 used to be. In modern Chinese it survives in fixed expressions and titles. Wherever you see 之, mentally substitute 的. The structure 名词 + 之 + 名词 = "X's Y" or "Y of X".

rows.translation: The beauty of China (= 中国的美)
The path to success
All in all ("to sum up and speak of it")

rows.pinyin: Yì jǔ liǎng dé zhī shì
rows.translation: Something that kills two birds with one stone

sections.text: 其 — "its / their / his / her"
其 (qí) is the literary third-person possessive — equivalent to 它的 / 他的 / 她的 / 他们的, depending on context. You'll meet it in essays, instructions, and idioms.

rows.translation: Its (the) result is shocking.
The company and its employees
Especially ("particularly its [case]")
Each takes what they need

sections.text: 所 — turning verbs into nouns

所 (suǒ) sits before a verb to nominalize the object: 所 + 动词 = "that which is V-ed". The full pattern is often 名词 + 所 + 动词 + 的 + 名词 = "the X that N V's". It feels ancient but appears constantly in titles and formal speech.

rows.translation: What I have seen (literally: that which I saw)
The efforts we have made
As is universally known
As reason dictates / naturally

sections.text: You almost never need to write 之/其/所 yourself in everyday Chinese. The goal is recognition: when you see 其, your brain swaps in 它的; when you see 所...的, you read it as "the thing that is V-ed".

lessons.title: Classical traces — 之 / 其

exercises.prompt: In "中国之美", 之 functions as ___

exercises.prompt: What does "成功之道" mean?
exercises.explanation: 之 = 的; 道 = way / path.

exercises.prompt: Pick the classical-vs-modern equivalent: "它的影响" rewrites in literary register as ___

exercises.prompt: Build "All in all, the impact of this work is far-reaching"

topics.title: News & journalism
topics.description: Read headlines, parse op-eds, follow current events

guide.intro: News Chinese is its own dialect — short, dense, and heavy with cause-effect connectives. Two patterns dominate explanatory writing: 之所以 X 是因为 Y for reverse-order causation, and 不仅 X 而且 Y for stacking points. Get fluent in these and headlines stop being puzzles.

sections.text: 之所以...是因为 — effect first, cause second

Standard order is 因为 X 所以 Y ("because X, so Y"). When you want to lead with the surprising effect and explain it after, flip to 之所以 Y 是因为 X ("the reason Y is because X"). It's a hallmark of essay and op-ed Chinese.

rows.source: 他之所以成功，是因为他从不放弃。
rows.pinyin: Tā zhī suǒ yǐ chénggōng, shì yīnwèi tā cóng bù fàngqì.
rows.translation: The reason he succeeded is that he never gave up.

rows.source: 中国之所以发展迅速，是因为改革开放的政策。
rows.pinyin: Zhōngguó zhī suǒ yǐ fāzhǎn xùnsù, shì yīnwèi gǎigé kāifàng de zhèngcè.
rows.translation: China developed rapidly because of the reform and opening-up policy.

sections.text: 不仅...而且 — "not only... but also"
不仅 X 而且 Y stacks points: not only X, but also Y. The formal form is 不但 X 而且 Y; the literary form 不仅...更 ramps up the second clause.

rows.source: 这部电影不仅获得了好评，而且票房火爆。
rows.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng bùjǐn huòdé le hǎopíng, érqiě piàofáng huǒbào.
rows.translation: This film not only got good reviews but also did huge box office.

rows.source: 他不仅是一位作家，更是一位思想家。
rows.pinyin: Tā bùjǐn shì yí wèi zuòjiā, gèng shì yí wèi sīxiǎngjiā.
rows.translation: He is not only a writer but, even more so, a thinker.

sections.text: Headline grammar
Headlines compress hard. They drop pronouns, particles, and even verbs. Learn these high-frequency journalist verbs and you'll skim headlines in seconds.
据 X 报道 — quick refresher

You met 据报道 at B2, so this is a refresher rather than new ground. At C1, focus on the variants: 据 X 报道 attributes to a named source, while 据悉 ("it is learned") is the unsourced, slightly official cousin. Both anchor the start of a sentence.

rows.source: 据新华社报道，会议将于下周举行。
rows.pinyin: Jù Xīnhuáshè bàodào, huìyì jiāng yú xiàzhōu jǔxíng.
rows.translation: According to Xinhua News Agency, the meeting will be held next week.

rows.source: 据悉，相关部门正在调查此事。
rows.pinyin: Jù xī, xiāngguān bùmén zhèngzài diàochá cǐ shì.
rows.translation: It is learned that the relevant departments are investigating the matter.

guide.intro: Persuasive Chinese has its own choreography: state your premise, acknowledge the counter-argument, then refute. Three structures power the dance — conditionals (要是...就/便, 即使...也), the concessive 虽然...但是, and the rhetorical 难道...吗.

sections.text: Conditionals

rows: As long as X, then Y

rows.translation: If only you had told me earlier.

rows.pinyin: Jíshǐ xiàyǔ, wǒmen yě yào qù.
rows.translation: Even if it rains, we are still going.

rows.source: 只要你努力，就一定会成功。
rows.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ nǔlì, jiù yídìng huì chénggōng.
rows.translation: As long as you work hard, you will surely succeed.

rows.source: 除非他道歉，否则我不会原谅他。
rows.pinyin: Chúfēi tā dàoqiàn, fǒuzé wǒ bú huì yuánliàng tā.
rows.translation: Unless he apologizes, I will not forgive him.

sections.text: 虽然...但是 — concede then push back
The strongest debaters concede. 虽然 X 但是 Y ("although X, but Y") signals you've heard the counterpoint and have an answer. Formal upgrade: 尽管 X，然而 Y.

rows.source: 虽然这个方案有风险，但是收益也很大。
rows.pinyin: Suīrán zhège fāng'àn yǒu fēngxiǎn, dànshì shōuyì yě hěn dà.
rows.translation: Although this plan has risks, the returns are also large.

rows.source: 尽管成本上升，然而公司仍然盈利。
rows.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn chéngběn shàngshēng, rán'ér gōngsī réngrán yínglì.
rows.translation: Although costs rose, the company is nevertheless still profitable.

sections.text: 难道...吗 — rhetorical question
难道 ("could it really be that") fronts a question to which the speaker assumes the answer is obvious. Used to challenge an assumption or rebuke.

rows.translation: Could it be that you don't know? (You should know!)

rows.pinyin: Nándào zhè jiù shì dá'àn ma?
rows.translation: Is this really the answer?

sections.text: In writing, balance your concessives. A column that opens with 虽然...但是 and closes with 难道...吗 reads as classic argumentative Chinese.

lessons.title: Stating your position
lessons.description: Open with confidence

exercises.prompt: the opener
Build "In my view, this view is one-sided"
exercises.answer: 在 我 看来 这个 观点 比较 片面

exercises.prompt: Which is most formal for "I firmly believe"?
exercises.explanation: All four are plausible C1 alternatives, but 坚信 ("firmly believe") is the strongest and most formal — 深信 is close behind, 相信 is neutral, 认定 leans toward "conclude / be convinced".

exercises.prompt: "毫无疑问" (háo wú yí wèn) means ___
Tap the verb of belief you hear
exercises.explanation: 认为 ("hold the view that") states a current belief; 以为 ("used to think / mistakenly thought") implies the speaker has since changed their mind. Mishearing one for the other flips the meaning.

exercises.prompt: Pick the strongest gradient ordering for verbs of belief:
options: 我深信 > 我坚信 > 我认为 > 我觉得 > 我以为 (mistaken)
我以为 > 我深信 > 我认为
我觉得 > 我深信 > 我以为
exercises.answer: 我深信 > 我坚信 > 我认为 > 我觉得 > 我以为 (mistaken)
exercises.explanation: Strength gradient runs from firm conviction to casual impression to mistaken prior view.

exercises.prompt: Build "In my humble view, this view, although appealing, is somewhat one-sided"
exercises.answer: 依 我 之 见 ， 这 一 观点 虽 具 吸引力 ， 但 略 显 片面

exercises.prompt: the position-marker to its register
Complete the formal opener: "在 ___ 看来，这一现象值得深思" (in our view)
exercises.explanation: 在我们看来 / 在我看来 = formal opinion frame.

exercises.prompt: Spot the register mismatch in this debate opener:
options: 依我之见，该方案存在严重缺陷
依我之见，这玩意儿压根不行
在我看来，这个方案存在缺陷
我认为该方案需要进一步完善
exercises.answer: 依我之见，这玩意儿压根不行
exercises.explanation: 依我之见 is literary; 这玩意儿/压根 are colloquial. Mixing them sounds jarring.

exercises.prompt: Tap the strength of conviction you hear
exercises.explanation: 我深信 / 我坚信 / 我相信 / 我认为 sit at four points on the strength dial. C1 listening discriminates them.

lessons.title: Conditionals — 要是, 即使, 只要
lessons.description: Build hypothetical arguments

exercises.prompt: What does "即使下雨我们也要去" mean?
options: If it rains we won't go
Even if it rains we are still going
If it stops raining we'll go
We are going only if it rains
exercises.answer: Even if it rains we are still going

exercises.prompt: Build "As long as you work hard, you will succeed"
exercises.answer: 只要 你 努力 ， 就 一定 会 成功

exercises.prompt: the conditional
Complete: "___ 他道歉，否则我不会原谅他" (Unless...)
Build "Even if there are setbacks along the way, we will not give up"
exercises.answer: 即使 途 中 遭遇 挫折 ， 我们 也 不会 放弃

exercises.prompt: What does "假如换个角度看，问题或许更清晰" mean?
options: If we look from another angle, the problem may be clearer
exercises.answer: If we look from another angle, the problem may be clearer
exercises.explanation: 假如 = formal "should / suppose"; 或许 = soft hedge "perhaps".

exercises.prompt: the conditional to its strength
Complete: "___ 你愿意倾听，对方就会愿意沟通" (As long as)
exercises.explanation: 只要 X 就 Y — sufficient-condition frame.

exercises.prompt: Tap the conditional you hear
exercises.spokenText: 除非他先道歉否则我们不会让步
options: 除非他先道歉否则我们不会让步
除非他先道歉否则我们一定让步
只要他先道歉我们就会让步
如果他先道歉我们就会让步
exercises.answer: 除非他先道歉否则我们不会让步
exercises.explanation: 除非...否则 vs 只要...就 vs 如果...就 differ in logic. C1 listening discriminates the necessary-condition frame.

exercises.prompt: Pick the formal hypothetical version of "if costs were to fall, demand would surge":
options: 假如成本下降，需求便会激增
要是成本掉了，需求就会涨
成本要是下来需求肯定上去
成本下来了需求就上去
exercises.answer: 假如成本下降，需求便会激增
exercises.explanation: 假如 + 便 + 激增 = formal economic-reasoning register.

exercises.prompt: Build "Even if it takes ten years, this goal still warrants the effort"
exercises.answer: 即使 需要 十 年 ， 这个 目标 仍 值得 我们 努力

lessons.title: Concede & refute
lessons.description: 虽然...但是 / 尽管...然而

exercises.prompt: Build "Although this plan has risks, the returns are large"
exercises.answer: 虽然 这个 方案 有 风险 ， 但是 收益 很 大

exercises.prompt: Which is the most formal version of "although...however"?
exercises.explanation: 尽管...然而 belongs in essays, news, and formal speech.

exercises.prompt: Pick the sentence that concedes a point and pushes back:
options: 你说得有道理，但是我们也要看到另一面
exercises.answer: 你说得有道理，但是我们也要看到另一面

exercises.prompt: "你说得有道理" means "what you say is ___"
Build "Although the opposing view has its rationale, we still need to see another side"
exercises.answer: 尽管 对方 的 观点 不无 道理 ， 然而 我们 仍需 看到 另一 面

exercises.prompt: What does the rebuttal structure "诚然...然而..." express?
options: Concede a point genuinely, then turn against it
exercises.answer: Concede a point genuinely, then turn against it
exercises.explanation: 诚然 ("granted / it is true that") + 然而 = a debater's classic concede-and-pivot.

exercises.prompt: the rebuttal opener
Tap the concession marker you hear
exercises.spokenText: 尽管成本上升然而公司仍然盈利
options: 尽管成本上升然而公司仍然盈利
虽然成本上升但是公司仍然盈利
尽管成本下降然而公司仍然盈利
尽管成本上升然而公司开始亏损
exercises.answer: 尽管成本上升然而公司仍然盈利
exercises.explanation: 尽管/虽然 differ in register; 上升/下降 inverts cause; 盈利/亏损 inverts result.

exercises.prompt: Spot the register mismatch in this concede-and-rebut:
options: 尽管对方观点有合理之处，然而问题在于其忽视了长期影响
尽管你说的没错啊，但是问题在于这玩意儿没用
诚然，该方案有其优势，然而风险亦不容忽视
话虽如此，仍需考虑实际操作的可行性
exercises.answer: 尽管你说的没错啊，但是问题在于这玩意儿没用
exercises.explanation: 尽管 lean formal; 你说的没错啊 / 这玩意儿没用 are casual. Mixed register sounds inconsistent.

exercises.prompt: Convert casual "虽然有问题但是值得尝试" to formal: "___ 存在 不足 ， ___ 仍 值得 尝试"
exercises.explanation: 尽管...然而 is the formal upgrade of 虽然...但是.

exercises.prompt: Build "That said, we still need to consider its impact on small and medium-sized enterprises"
exercises.answer: 话 虽 如此 ， 我们 仍 需 考虑 其 对 中小 企业 的 影响

lessons.title: Rhetorical questions — 难道...吗
lessons.description: Sharpen a point with a challenge

exercises.prompt: What does "难道你不知道吗？" really mean?
options: A genuine question — does he/she know?
exercises.explanation: 难道...吗 expects the answer "of course" or "of course not".

exercises.prompt: Build the rhetorical "Could this really be the only solution?"
exercises.answer: 难道 这 是 唯一 的 解决 办法 吗

exercises.prompt: the rhetorical opener
"难道你忘了吗？" implies you ___ have forgotten
exercises.explanation: Rhetorically, the speaker assumes you remember.

exercises.prompt: Build the rhetorical "If even this is not a problem, then what could possibly be a problem?"
exercises.answer: 如果 这 都 不 算 问题 ， 那 还有 什么 算 问题 呢

exercises.prompt: What does "试问，谁能在此情况下保持冷静？" really argue?
options: Nobody could stay calm under such circumstances
exercises.answer: Nobody could stay calm under such circumstances
exercises.explanation: 试问 ("I ask") fronts a rhetorical challenge. The expected answer is the negative.

exercises.prompt: the advanced rhetorical question opener
Tap the rhetorical opener you hear
exercises.spokenText: 难道我们就这样放弃吗
options: 难道我们就这样放弃吗
难道我们就这样坚持吗
难道你们就这样放弃吗
我们难道这样放弃了吗
exercises.answer: 难道我们就这样放弃吗
exercises.explanation: Listen for 我们/你们 (we/you), 放弃/坚持 (give up/persist), and word order — all classic C1 traps.

exercises.prompt: Pick the literary rhetorical "how could we possibly tolerate this?":
exercises.explanation: 岂能 ("how could one possibly") + 此事 ("this matter") = literary register.

exercises.prompt: Complete the rhetorical opener: "___ 这就是事实的全部？" (could it really be that)
exercises.explanation: 难道 fronts a question with an obvious-to-the-speaker answer.

exercises.prompt: Build the literary rhetorical "How could we ignore so many warnings?"
exercises.answer: 如此 多 的 警告 ， 我们 岂 能 视而 不见

lessons.title: Dialogue: Panel rebuttal — concede and push back
lessons.description: Rebut an opponent on a televised panel using concede-then-pivot tactics

exercises.prompt: On a televised debate panel, an opponent attacks your position on AI regulation.

turns.speaker: opp
turns.text: 您主张严格监管人工智能，这岂不是扼杀创新？
turns.spokenText: 您主张严格监管人工智能，这岂不是扼杀创新

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Concede the partial truth then pivot — formal register
options: 韩先生所言不无道理，然而无监管之创新，终将反噬社会。
你说的有点对啦但是不管也不行啊。
你说得对但是我还是不同意。
turns.answer: 韩先生所言不无道理，然而无监管之创新，终将反噬社会。

turns.speaker: opp
turns.text: 可监管措施往往滞后于技术，岂非形同虚设？
turns.spokenText: 可监管措施往往滞后于技术，岂非形同虚设

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Fill in the 4-character idiom for "better late than never"
turns.answer: 亡羊补牢

turns.speaker: opp
turns.text: 您难道认为政府比工程师更了解技术？
turns.spokenText: 您难道认为政府比工程师更了解技术

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Reframe the question — use 并非 to deny the false premise
options: 我并非主张政府精通技术，而是强调公共利益须有制度保障。
我不是说政府懂技术啦我是说要管。
你扯远了我没说政府懂。
turns.answer: 我并非主张政府精通技术，而是强调公共利益须有制度保障。

turns.speaker: opp
turns.text: 可若监管过严，企业必将外迁，国家如何获益？
turns.spokenText: 可若监管过严，企业必将外迁，国家如何获益

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Push back using rhetorical question — 难道...吗
options: 难道为求短期产值，便要放弃对社会的长期责任吗？
你的意思就是赚钱最重要呗？
外迁就外迁呗有什么了不起。
turns.answer: 难道为求短期产值，便要放弃对社会的长期责任吗？

turns.speaker: opp
turns.text: 那您建议的监管框架，核心原则是什么？
turns.spokenText: 那您建议的监管框架，核心原则是什么

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Fill in 既然...就 — "since ... then"
turns.after: 技术影响深远，就应以风险分级为本，重者严管，轻者宽松。
turns.answer: 既然

turns.speaker: opp
turns.text: 在此一点上，我与您所见略同。
turns.spokenText: 在此一点上，我与您所见略同

topics.title: Chéngyǔ in context
topics.description: Eight high-frequency four-character idioms used the right way

guide.intro: 成语 (chéngyǔ) are four-character idioms that compress a story or principle into one phrase. There are thousands of them, but only a few hundred are actually high-frequency. We'll meet eight that you'll see weekly in news, conversation, and writing — and learn the contexts where each lands well.

sections.text: How idioms slot into sentences

成语 typically work as adjectives, adverbs, or full predicates. Most can stand alone as a four-character verb phrase: 一举两得 ("two birds, one stone") can be the whole verb. Some need a 是 or 的 frame to slot in: 这是一举两得的事.

rows.pinyin: Zhè zhēn shì yì jǔ liǎng dé.
rows.translation: This really is killing two birds with one stone.

rows.pinyin: Tā gōngzuò bàn tú ér fèi.
rows.translation: He gave up halfway through the work.

rows.pinyin: Jǐn shàng tiān huā de shèjì
rows.translation: An icing-on-the-cake design

sections.text: Eight to remember

rows: Win-win solution / two birds, one stone
Help when help is most needed
Enter the village, follow its customs
When in Rome, do as the Romans

sections.text: 锦上添花 vs 雪中送炭
These two are taught as a pair. 锦上添花 is help when things are already good — nice but not vital. 雪中送炭 is help in a crisis — the kind people remember forever. Pick the right one when praising someone.

rows.pinyin: Nǐ zhè shì xuě zhōng sòng tàn, xièxie!
rows.translation: This is help when I really needed it — thank you!

rows.source: 不算什么，只是锦上添花。
rows.pinyin: Bú suàn shénme, zhǐshì jǐn shàng tiān huā.
rows.translation: It's nothing, just a small bonus.

sections.text: Don't pile 成语 on top of 成语. One per paragraph in writing, one per minute in speech. Used sparingly they sound elegant; used densely they sound like a textbook.

lessons.title: Win-win — 一举两得
lessons.description: And its sibling 一石二鸟

exercises.prompt: What does "一举两得" literally mean?
exercises.explanation: 一举 = one move; 两得 = two gains.

exercises.prompt: Build "This plan is really a two-birds-one-stone solution"
exercises.answer: 这个 方案 真是 一举两得

exercises.prompt: Which situation best fits "一举两得"?
options: Walking the dog AND getting exercise
exercises.answer: Walking the dog AND getting exercise

exercises.prompt: "一石二鸟" is the equivalent of "___ stone, two birds"
the idiom to its classical story

pairs.right: Han-era essay: one move gains two ends
Tale of throwing one stone to fell two birds
Mencius: half the effort, double the result
Mencius: fish and bear-paw can rarely both be had

exercises.prompt: Pick the literal-vs-figurative distinction for 一举两得:
options: Literal: 'one lift, two gains'; Figurative: 'achieve two aims with one action'
It only has a literal meaning
It only has a figurative meaning
exercises.answer: Literal: 'one lift, two gains'; Figurative: 'achieve two aims with one action'
exercises.explanation: 一举 literally means 'one lift / one move'; 两得 literally means 'two gains'. The modern figurative use is 'kill two birds with one stone'.

exercises.prompt: Build the headline-style "Renewable energy: economic and environmental two-birds-one-stone"
exercises.answer: 可再生 能源 ： 经济 与 环保 一举两得

exercises.prompt: Complete the news context: "骑车上下班 ___，既环保又锻炼" (kills two birds with one stone)
exercises.explanation: 一举两得 fits a benefit-stacking situation perfectly.

exercises.prompt: Tap the idiom you hear
exercises.explanation: All four start with 一. Listen for 举两得 (action, two gains) vs 无所获 (no gain) vs 鸣惊人 (sudden fame) vs 蹴而就 (achieved at one go).

exercises.prompt: Spot the misused 成语:
options: 他每天跑步上班，既锻炼了身体又节省了交通费，真是一举两得
他下班后回家做饭，真是一举两得
他失败了，真是一举两得
我们既能学习又能赚钱，可谓一举两得
exercises.answer: 他失败了，真是一举两得
exercises.explanation: 一举两得 requires two positive outcomes from one action. Pairing it with simple failure is a misuse.

exercises.prompt: Build "This policy can not only stimulate the economy but also create jobs — truly a two-birds-one-stone solution"
exercises.answer: 这 项 政策 不仅 能 刺激 经济 ， 还 能 创造 就业 ， 实 为 一举两得

lessons.title: Quitting halfway — 半途而废
lessons.description: And the opposite: 坚持不懈

exercises.prompt: What does "半途而废" describe?
Build "Don't give up halfway, persistence brings success"
exercises.answer: 不要 半途而废 ， 坚持 才 能 成功

exercises.prompt: the idiom to its meaning
"坚持不懈" — 不懈 means "without ___"
Pick the literal-vs-figurative distinction for 半途而废:
options: Literal: 'on the road, halfway, then abandoned'; Figurative: 'give up halfway through'
It only has a literal meaning
It only has a figurative meaning
exercises.answer: Literal: 'on the road, halfway, then abandoned'; Figurative: 'give up halfway through'
exercises.explanation: 半途 = halfway on the road; 而废 = and abandon. Story comes from the 礼记 tale of the wife who cuts her unfinished weaving to teach her husband not to quit study.

exercises.prompt: Build "If we give up halfway now, all our previous efforts will be in vain"
exercises.answer: 如果 现在 半途而废 ， 之前 所有 的 努力 都 将 前功尽弃

exercises.prompt: Complete the editorial: "科研之路漫长，唯有 ___ 方能有所突破" (perseverance)
exercises.explanation: 唯有 X 方能 Y = formal "only by X can one Y". 坚持不懈 fits the long-haul mission perfectly.

exercises.prompt: Tap the idiom you hear
exercises.explanation: 半途而废 (give up halfway) vs 坚持不懈 (persevere) — opposite qualities. 全力以赴 (give it all) and 前功尽弃 (waste prior effort) are different shades.

exercises.prompt: Spot the misused 成语:
options: 他攻读博士四年，从未半途而废
他买了菜，吃完了，真是半途而废
项目刚到一半就停了，等于半途而废
exercises.answer: 他买了菜，吃完了，真是半途而废
exercises.explanation: 半途而废 requires giving up an unfinished task. Eating bought food to completion is finishing, not abandoning halfway.

exercises.prompt: the perseverance idiom to its meaning
Build "As long as we persevere, we will surely reach our goal"
exercises.answer: 只要 我们 坚持不懈 ， 就 一定 能 达到 目标

lessons.title: 锦上添花 vs 雪中送炭
lessons.description: Bonus help vs critical help

exercises.prompt: A friend lends you money when you're broke. They are providing ___
exercises.explanation: 雪中送炭 = help in a crisis — "sending charcoal in the snow".

exercises.prompt: Adding extra dessert to an already-feast is ___
exercises.explanation: Already-good situation + bonus = "adding flowers to brocade".

exercises.prompt: Build "What you did was truly help in time of need"
exercises.answer: 你 这 真 是 雪中送炭

exercises.prompt: "锦" originally means ___ — fine brocade silk
exercises.explanation: 锦 specifically refers to brocade or patterned silk — distinct from 绣 (embroidery).

exercises.prompt: Build "At the most difficult moment, your help was truly help in time of need"
exercises.answer: 在 我 最 困难 的 时候 ， 你 的 帮助 真是 雪中送炭

exercises.prompt: Pick the right idiom: a wealthy company donates to disaster relief — bystanders praise this as ___
exercises.explanation: Disaster victims are in crisis — 雪中送炭 fits. 锦上添花 would suggest the recipients were already fine.

exercises.prompt: Complete: "她已经够优秀了，这次得奖只能算 ___" (icing on the cake)
exercises.explanation: 锦上添花 fits when the recipient is already in a good state.

exercises.prompt: Tap the idiom you hear
exercises.explanation: 雪中送炭 (crisis help) vs 锦上添花 (bonus help) — context-critical pair to discriminate.

exercises.prompt: Pick the literal-vs-figurative distinction for 锦上添花:
options: Literal: 'add flowers atop brocade'; Figurative: 'make a good thing better'
It only has a literal meaning
It only has a figurative meaning
exercises.answer: Literal: 'add flowers atop brocade'; Figurative: 'make a good thing better'
exercises.explanation: 锦 = brocade silk; 添花 = add flowers. Already-fine becomes finer.

exercises.prompt: the help-related idiom to its meaning

pairs.right: Bonus on top of an already-good thing
Kick someone when they are down

topics.title: Abstract & philosophical
topics.description: Talk about ideas, ethics, fate, and meaning

guide.intro: Modern Mandarin still leans on a small cluster of fate-and-cause vocabulary inherited from Confucian, Buddhist, and Daoist thought. Three words do most of the work: 缘分 (fated connection), 因果 (cause and effect), and 命运 (destiny). They aren't religious jargon — speakers use them every day to talk about relationships, outcomes, and choices. Learning the cultural framing keeps you from translating them too flatly.

sections.text: 缘分 — the right people, the right time

缘分 (yuán fèn) names the unseen tie that brings two people, or a person and a place, together. It's used loosely in romance ("we have 缘分"), friendship ("我们很有缘"), and even chance encounters. The Buddhist root is 缘 ("condition that gives rise to a meeting"); the modern register is warm, slightly fatalistic, and very common.

rows.source: 我们能再见面，真是缘分。
rows.pinyin: Wǒmen néng zài jiànmiàn, zhēn shì yuán fèn.
rows.translation: That we could meet again is truly fate.

rows.pinyin: Yǒu yuán qiān lǐ lái xiāng huì.
rows.translation: If fated, even a thousand miles can't keep two from meeting.

rows.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì jiù suí yuán ba.
rows.translation: Let's just let this one go where fate takes it.

sections.text: 因果 — cause and effect

因果 (yīn guǒ) literally pairs 因 (cause) with 果 (fruit / result). In Buddhist usage it names karma; in modern speech it works as a neutral "cause and effect" — useful in argument, science writing, and ethics talk alike. The four-character expression 因果报应 ("karmic retribution") keeps the moral edge.

rows.pinyin: Fán shì dōu yǒu yīn guǒ.
rows.translation: Every event has a cause and an effect.

rows.source: 我们要分析这件事的因果关系。
rows.pinyin: Wǒmen yào fēnxī zhè jiàn shì de yīn guǒ guānxi.
rows.translation: We need to analyse the causal relationship of this matter.

rows.pinyin: Zhòng shàn yīn, dé shàn guǒ.
rows.translation: Plant good causes, reap good fruits.

sections.text: 命运 — destiny you can argue with

命运 (mìng yùn) is destiny, but with more give than the English word suggests. Speakers talk about 改变命运 ("change one's destiny") and 与命运抗争 ("struggle against fate") freely — destiny is fixed enough to name, fluid enough to push against. Adjacent terms: 天命 (heavenly mandate, more solemn), 宿命 (predetermined fate, fatalistic).

rows: Neutral; can be changed in modern usage

sections.text: These words sit in everyday conversation, not just temples. A friend who lands a job they nearly missed will say 这就是缘分; a parent reflecting on a child's path will say 改变命运. Don't over-translate them as "karma" or "fate" — let the context pick the English.

exercises.prompt: Which compound sentence correctly combines a concession, a topic frame, and a strong conclusion?

虽然挑战不少但是这战略反正没问题

exercises.answer: 尽管挑战不少，然而就长远而言，这一战略毋庸置疑是正确的
exercises.explanation: Three formal moves stack: 尽管...然而 (concession), 就...而言 (topic frame), 毋庸置疑 (strong claim).

exercises.prompt: the connective stack to its function

exercises.explanation: 鉴于 X 因此 Y is the formal causal frame in op-ed Chinese.

lessons.title: Read like a native

exercises.prompt: What does "鉴于近期市场波动，公司因此暂缓上市" mean?

Given recent market volatility, the company is therefore postponing its IPO
The company canceled the IPO permanently
The market is stable so the IPO continues
exercises.answer: Given recent market volatility, the company is therefore postponing its IPO
exercises.explanation: 鉴于 X 因此 Y is the formal causal frame; 暂缓 = postpone temporarily.

exercises.prompt: What does "众所周知，气候变化是全人类共同面临的挑战" mean?

As is well known, climate change is a challenge faced by all of humanity together
Climate change is a recent discovery
Climate change only affects some countries
exercises.answer: As is well known, climate change is a challenge faced by all of humanity together

exercises.prompt: Which sentence uses 是...的 emphasis?
exercises.explanation: 是...的 frames the time (去年) as the focused element.

exercises.prompt: "任重道远" expresses that the ___ is heavy and the road is long
exercises.explanation: Used to admit a long, arduous mission ahead.

exercises.prompt: What does the editorial line "由此可见，该现象的产生有其深层原因" mean?
options: From this it can be seen that the phenomenon has deep underlying causes
exercises.answer: From this it can be seen that the phenomenon has deep underlying causes

lessons.title: Complements — 得 / 不 / 完 / 光 / 掉 / 破

exercises.prompt: What does "这么多菜我吃不完" mean?
options: I don't want to eat so many dishes
I can't possibly finish so many dishes
I have not eaten the dishes
I am still eating the dishes
exercises.answer: I can't possibly finish so many dishes
exercises.explanation: 吃不完 is the potential complement: V + 不 + 完 = "unable to finish V-ing". Positive form: 吃得完 ("can finish").

exercises.prompt: the result complement to its sense
Build "This wine is so good we'll definitely finish it"

exercises.prompt: Insert the right complement: "票卖 ___ 了" (the tickets are sold out)

exercises.prompt: What does "想得开" mean?
options: Be able to think it through / let it go (potential complement)
exercises.answer: Be able to think it through / let it go (potential complement)

lessons.description: 见过面, 帮了一个忙, 结过婚

exercises.prompt: Why is "我见面他了" wrong?
options: 见面 is a separable verb — the object goes in the middle: 我见过他的面 / 我跟他见过面
见面 only takes a time word
exercises.answer: 见面 is a separable verb — the object goes in the middle: 我见过他的面 / 我跟他见过面
exercises.explanation: Separable verbs (离合词) like 见面, 帮忙, 结婚 are V-O compounds. You can't tack a second object on; aspect markers and modifiers go between the two halves.

Build "He did me a big favor yesterday"

exercises.explanation: With 离合词, the experience marker 过 follows the verb-half (见), and the count phrase splits the compound: 见过两次面.

exercises.explanation: 担心 is a 离合词. The duration splits between 担 and 心: 担了三天心.

exercises.prompt: Convert "我们见面三次了" into the correct 离合词 form: "我们见 ___ 三次面 ___"
exercises.explanation: 见过/了 + 三次 + 面 + 了 — duration splits the compound.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence shows correct separable-verb negation?
exercises.explanation: 没 + 结 + 过 + 婚 — 没 sits before the verb-half, 过 follows the verb-half.

exercises.prompt: Build "They have danced together three times"
exercises.answer: 他们 一起 跳 过 三 次 舞

lessons.description: 一番, 一阵, 一笔, 一项, 一系列

levels.name: C2 — Mastery
levels.description: Read novels, parse classical-flavored prose, debate philosophy, and switch register at will.

topics.title: Classical echoes (文言)
topics.description: The 之/其/所/而 family — and how they survive in modern formal writing

guide.intro: You will not be writing 文言 (wényán, classical Chinese) — almost no one does. But every Chinese newspaper editorial, legal document, government report, and serious novel is studded with classical particles, fossilized syntax, and four-character compressions that only make sense if you can read the classical underneath. Treat this as the X-ray vision unit.

sections.text: 之 (zhī) — the all-purpose connector

In modern colloquial Chinese 之 is replaced by 的. In formal writing 之 returns: it links a modifier to a noun (爱国之心 — "a heart of patriotism"), substitutes for an object pronoun (取而代之 — "take it and replace it"), and lurks inside dozens of 成语. Whenever you see 之 in a modern text, mentally swap in 的 or "it" and the sentence usually clicks.

rows.translation: What is said has reason — "that has merit."
To sum it up — used to open a closing paragraph.
A treasure of no price — priceless.

sections.text: 其 (qí) — "its / their / the said"

其 is the formal third-person possessive and a gentle determiner. In a contract you will read 其责任 (its/the responsibility). In an editorial: 其原因有三 (the reasons are three). Notice it never takes 的 after it.

rows.translation: In fact (lit. "its truth").
Each gets their proper place.
Among them / within it.

sections.text: 所 (suǒ) — turns a verb into "that which is V-ed"

所 + verb makes a passive-flavored relative clause: 所说 (that which is said), 所做 (that which is done), 所谓 (so-called). Pair it with 的 in modern usage to keep it readable: 我所说的话 — "the words I said." Reporters love this construction.

rows.translation: As is known to all — newspaper opener.
Unprecedented (lit. "never before existed").
The so-called experts — heavy with skepticism.

sections.text: 而 (ér) — "and / yet / and so"

而 fuses two predicates. Coordinative (年轻而有为 — young and capable), adversative (富而不骄 — rich yet not arrogant), or sequential (起而行之 — rise and act). Modern formal speech is full of it: spoken 而 sounds bookish; written 而 sounds polished.

Quick test: if you can replace 而 with English "and", "yet", or "thus" without losing the sense, you've parsed it. If none fit, you're probably looking at the fossilized 然而 (however) or 因而 (therefore).
Other classical fossils still alive

rows: 以…为… ("take X as Y"), 以便, 以免
若…则… ("if…then…"), 否则, 然则
几乎, 在乎, 不亦乐乎
记者, 学者, 读者, 强者
之乎者也 — the cliché of pedantry

sections.text: 之乎者也 (zhī hū zhě yě) is itself an idiom — it means "empty pedantic talk," mocking someone who hides behind classical jargon.

Don't conflate the two 也. Modern 也 is the high-frequency adverb "also / too" (我也去 — "I'm going too"). Classical 也 is a sentence-final marker that functioned roughly as a copula or assertion (… ， … 也 — "… is the case"). Same character, completely different jobs. In the table above, 也 is listed under its classical job; in everyday reading 99% of 也 you'll see is the modern adverb.
Literary number pairs

In literary or written-elevated register, paired numbers function adverbially to mean "a few / scattered." 一二 (yī èr) — "one or two," 三五 (sān wǔ) — "a handful," 七八 (qī bā) — "seven or eight, a small group." These appear in essays, captions, and novels — almost never in speech.

rows.source: 三五 好友 围炉 夜话。
rows.translation: A handful of close friends chatting around the stove at night.

rows.source: 一二 行人 匆匆 而 过。
rows.pinyin: Yī èr xíngrén cōngcōng ér guò.
rows.translation: A pedestrian or two hurrying past.

lessons.title: 之 in modern prose
lessons.description: Spot 之 inside fixed phrases and editorials

exercises.prompt: In a modern editorial, 之 most often functions like which colloquial particle?
exercises.explanation: 之 is the formal counterpart of 的 — it links a modifier to a noun in elevated register. The other particles (地 adverbial, 得 complement, 而 connector) handle distinct grammatical jobs.

exercises.prompt: the 之-idiom to its meaning
An economics column ends with "总而言之，通胀压力未减。" What is the writer signaling?
exercises.explanation: 总而言之 = "in conclusion / all in all" — a discourse marker for the wrap-up paragraph.

exercises.prompt: "爱国之心" (ài guó zhī xīn) translates as ___
Which sentence uses 之 in its classical-modern formal sense (modifier-linker)?
options: 他 走 之 后 我 才 来
国家 之 强盛 在 于 民
我 也 去 之
之 是 什么 意思
exercises.answer: 国家 之 强盛 在 于 民
exercises.explanation: 国家之强盛 ("the strength of the nation") uses 之 as the formal modifier-linker = 的. The other options misuse 之 — option 1 is a fixed adverbial (走之后 is colloquial 之后), the others ungrammatical.

exercises.prompt: Build a long formal sentence: "The development of artificial intelligence is the great trend of our age, and it is irreversible."
exercises.answer: 人工智能 之 发展 乃 时代 之 大势 不可 逆转

exercises.prompt: A speaker reads a formal editorial line. Pick what you hear.
exercises.spokenText: 言之有理，行之有效，方为治世之策
options: 言之有理，行之有效，方为治世之策
说得有道理，做得很有效，才是治理的好办法
言而有信，行而果断，是治世的关键
话说得对，事做得好，国家就能治理
exercises.answer: 言之有理，行之有效，方为治世之策
exercises.explanation: Three uses of 之 (modifier-linker) plus 方为 (literary 才是) and 之策 (formal -strategy). The other options paraphrase the same idea in modern colloquial or near-colloquial register.

exercises.prompt: each 之-construction to the modern 的-equivalent (or paraphrase)

pairs.right: 改革的困难 — the difficulty of reform
一天的功夫 — a single day's effort
国家的根本 — the root of the nation
切身的痛苦 — pain felt in the flesh

exercises.prompt: An editorial reads "非一日之功可解." The 非…可… pattern is:
options: Classical negation pattern — "not something a day's effort can solve"
exercises.answer: Classical negation pattern — "not something a day's effort can solve"
exercises.explanation: 非 X 可 Y = literary "not X-able by Y" — a fossilized classical negation that survives in editorials. Modern colloquial would say "不是一天就能解决的."

exercises.prompt: An editorial closes: "扶贫攻坚，非 ___ 之 ___ 可 成." Fill the two-character pair (a single day's effort).
exercises.explanation: 非一日之功可成 — "cannot be done in a day's effort." A boilerplate editorial closer that quietly hedges expectations.

lessons.title: 其 and 所 — formal relatives
lessons.description: The two particles that turn modern prose into a contract

exercises.prompt: "其原因有三" most naturally means:
exercises.explanation: 其 = "its/their"; 有三 = "are three (in number)." Classic essay-opener.

exercises.prompt: "所谓的专家" carries which tone?
exercises.explanation: 所谓 = "so-called." Almost always loaded with doubt or sarcasm in modern usage.

exercises.prompt: the 所-phrase to its meaning

pairs.right: Naturally / as a matter of course

exercises.prompt: Build: "This is what we said." (formal)
exercises.answer: 这 是 我们 所 说 的

exercises.prompt: A contract reads "其责任 由 甲方 承担." 其 here refers to:
options: The responsibility just defined in the prior clause
exercises.answer: The responsibility just defined in the prior clause
exercises.explanation: 其 = formal possessive/anaphor — "its responsibility" (i.e., the responsibility belonging to whatever was last named). Standard contract glue.

exercises.prompt: Build a contract clause: "The responsibility for it shall be borne by Party A; the costs shall also be paid by Party A."
exercises.answer: 其 责任 由 甲方 承担 其 费用 亦 由 甲方 支付

exercises.prompt: A reporter reads a sentence stuffed with 所 and 其. Pick the formal version.
exercises.spokenText: 众所周知，其影响之深远，前所未有
options: 众所周知，其影响之深远，前所未有
大家都知道，这影响很深远，从来没有过
据说，这事影响很大，是头一回
我们清楚，影响很大，史上第一次
exercises.answer: 众所周知，其影响之深远，前所未有
exercises.explanation: Two 所-constructions (众所周知, 前所未有), 其 + 之 chain. The distractors paraphrase in modern colloquial, official, or semi-formal registers.

exercises.prompt: A government white paper writes "___ 周知，气候变化已成全球共同挑战." Fill in the four-character all-knowing opener.
exercises.explanation: 众所周知 = "as is known to all" — the canonical 所-construction opener for editorials and policy papers.

exercises.prompt: each 其/所 phrase to its discourse function
Which sentence uses 所 INCORRECTLY for a C2 reader?
exercises.explanation: 所 + verb forms a noun-clause but only with transitive verbs taking an object that becomes the head — and 所吃饭 is ungrammatical because 吃饭 is already V+O. Correct would be 我所吃的饭. The other three are well-formed.

lessons.title: 而 — the bookish glue
lessons.description: And, yet, thus — depending on what flanks it

exercises.prompt: "富而不骄" (fù ér bù jiāo) means:
exercises.explanation: Adversative 而 — "X yet not Y." A standard literary praise pattern.

exercises.prompt: Pick the most natural translation: "年轻而有为"
exercises.explanation: Coordinative 而 — both qualities hold. 有为 (yǒu wéi) = "capable / promising."

exercises.prompt: Build: "He spoke briefly yet to the point."
exercises.answer: 他 说 得 简短 而 中肯

exercises.prompt: Modern formal connector "然而" means ___
exercises.explanation: 然而 = literally "yet-and"; the workhorse contrastive in essays.

exercises.prompt: A literary-register sentence is read aloud. Pick what you hear.
exercises.spokenText: 众所周知，前所未有之变局，非一日之功可解
options: 众所周知，前所未有之变局，非一日之功可解
大家都知道，这种没见过的局面，不是一天就能解决的
我们都明白，这是从来没有过的事情，需要时间
据报道，目前局势复杂，有关部门正在研究
exercises.answer: 众所周知，前所未有之变局，非一日之功可解
exercises.explanation: Classical fossils all stacked: 众所周知 (所), 前所未有 (所), 之 (formal of), 非…可解 (classical negation pattern). The other options say similar things in modern colloquial or official register.

exercises.prompt: "取而代之" — what is the role of 而 here?
exercises.explanation: 取而代之 = "take, and replace it." The 而 here is the sequential connector — first 取, then 代之.

exercises.prompt: Build a literary-balanced sentence: "He is young yet steady; he speaks little but acts decisively."
exercises.answer: 他 年轻 而 沉稳 言 寡 而 行 果

exercises.prompt: the 而-phrase to its function (coordinative / adversative / sequential)

pairs.right: Fossilized discourse marker — to sum up

exercises.prompt: An essay reads: "政策推行 三年，___ 收效甚微." Fill the formal contrastive connector (one character).
exercises.explanation: 然 (or 然而) — formal "yet/however." The single-character 然 is the most literary; 然而 is essay-standard. 但 is more conversational.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence-final 也 is the CLASSICAL copula (not the modern "also")?
options: 他 也 不 知道
此 乃 国 之 大 事 也
你 也 来 了
exercises.answer: 此 乃 国 之 大 事 也
exercises.explanation: Classical 也 is sentence-final and assertion-like (≈ "is the case"). Pairs naturally with 此乃 ("this is") + 之 in literary register. The other three are modern adverbial 也 = "also/too."

lessons.title: 以、则、者 — the rest of the toolkit
lessons.description: Three more classical particles you'll trip over weekly

exercises.prompt: "以…为…" means:
options: Take X as / regard X as Y
exercises.answer: Take X as / regard X as Y
exercises.explanation: 以学生为本 = "take students as the foundation" — boilerplate education-policy phrasing. (The canonical example is 以人为本 — rén-běn — "put people first," the Hu-era policy slogan.)

exercises.prompt: Build: "Our company puts the customer first." (use 以…为…)
exercises.answer: 我们 公司 以 客户 为 本

exercises.prompt: "若…则…" is the formal counterpart of which everyday pattern?
exercises.explanation: Both are conditionals. 若…则… is the literary register; 要是…就… is colloquial.

exercises.prompt: the 者-noun to its meaning
"之乎者也" describes someone who ___
exercises.answer: Speaks pretentiously / hides behind pedantic jargon
exercises.explanation: All four are classical particles bundled together — a label for hollow learnedness.

exercises.prompt: the classical compression to its modern function (these still appear in editorials and legal documents)

pairs.right: Therefore / for this reason (= 因此, formal)
That being so / in that case (= 那么)
Why is that? (rhetorical question, = 为什么)
X's relation to Y / X compared to Y

exercises.prompt: A legal opinion contains: "是以本院驳回原告之诉讼请求." The 是以 functions as:
exercises.explanation: 是以 = 因此 / 所以 in elevated register. Watch for it in court opinions, government white papers, and editorial conclusions.

exercises.prompt: Build a formal conditional: "If the policy goes through, then the people will benefit; if not, then losses will mount day by day."
exercises.answer: 政策 若 行 则 民 受 其 利 不 行 则 损 日 增

exercises.prompt: A speaker reads a 文言-flavored editorial close. Pick what you hear.
exercises.spokenText: 是以本部门决定，自即日起，相关政策依法施行
options: 是以本部门决定，自即日起，相关政策依法施行
因此我们部门决定，从今天开始，相关政策按法律执行
所以这个部门决定，从这天开始，要按规定办理
据此，部门已经决定，今天起就开始执行
exercises.answer: 是以本部门决定，自即日起，相关政策依法施行
exercises.explanation: 是以 (formal 因此), 本部门 (this department), 自即日起 (formal 从今天开始), 依法施行 (formal "executed in accordance with law") — four register markers. The distractors translate the same content into ordinary or near-formal Chinese.

exercises.prompt: Pair completion: "___ 你 已 决定，则 不必 再 犹豫." Fill the literary premise marker (two characters).
exercises.explanation: 既然…则… (literary) = 既然…就… (modern). Both halves carry the conclusion forward; 则 is the bookish counterpart of 就.

exercises.prompt: Which use of 以 is the CLASSICAL "in order to / so as to" (purpose)?
options: 他 以 学生 的 身份 发言
我 以 此 为 戒 以 免 重 蹈 覆辙
用 这个 方法 解决
我 以为 他 不来
exercises.answer: 我 以 此 为 戒 以 免 重 蹈 覆辙
exercises.explanation: The second 以 in 以免 ("so as to avoid") is the classical purpose marker — same root as 以便 ("so as to facilitate"). The first 以 here is 以…为… ("take… as…"); option 1 is identity-marking 以; option 4 is the verb 以为 ("think").

lessons.title: Dialogue: Book club on a classical text
lessons.description: Debate a passage from 庄子 and how its particles survive in modern prose.

exercises.prompt: Book club on a classical text

turns.speaker: wei
turns.text: 今晚我们读《庄子》的一段，关于无用之用。(jīn wǎn wǒmen dú zhuāngzǐ de yī duàn, guānyú wú yòng zhī yòng.)
turns.spokenText: 今晚我们读《庄子》的一段，关于无用之用。

turns.speaker: wei
turns.text: 原文是「人皆知有用之用，而莫知无用之用也」。(rén jiē zhī yǒu yòng zhī yòng, ér mò zhī wú yòng zhī yòng yě.)
turns.spokenText: 人皆知有用之用，而莫知无用之用也。

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Which colloquial particle does 之 here correspond to?
turns.answer: 的 (de)

turns.speaker: wei
turns.text: 对，「有用之用」即「有用的用处」。那句末的「也」呢？(duì, yǒu yòng zhī yòng jí yǒu yòng de yòng chu. nà jù mò de yě ne?)
turns.spokenText: 对，「有用之用」即「有用的用处」。那句末的「也」呢？

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: What is sentence-final 也 doing here?
options: Classical assertion marker, roughly a copula (yě – classical)
turns.answer: Classical assertion marker, roughly a copula (yě – classical)

turns.speaker: wei
turns.text: 正是。现代社论里也常用「不可不察也」收尾。(zhèng shì. xiàn dài shè lùn lǐ yě cháng yòng bù kě bù chá yě shōu wěi.)
turns.spokenText: 正是。现代社论里也常用「不可不察也」收尾。

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Fill the classical particle: "as for ..." (其...) — give the formal third-person/topic marker.
turns.after: 言深远，发人深省。(yán shēn yuǎn, fā rén shēn xǐng.)
turns.answer: 其

turns.speaker: wei
turns.text: 妙！「其言」即「他的话」。最后看「众所周知」之「所」。(miào! qí yán jí tā de huà. zuì hòu kàn zhòng suǒ zhōu zhī zhī suǒ.)
turns.spokenText: 妙！「其言」即「他的话」。最后看「众所周知」之「所」。

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 所 + verb forms what kind of phrase?
options: A passive-flavored relative clause: "that which is V-ed"
turns.answer: A passive-flavored relative clause: "that which is V-ed"

turns.speaker: wei
turns.text: 好。下周读《论语》，请把今晚的之乎者也都消化掉。(hǎo. xià zhōu dú lúnyǔ, qǐng bǎ jīn wǎn de zhī hū zhě yě dōu xiāo huà diào.)
turns.spokenText: 好。下周读《论语》，请把今晚的之乎者也都消化掉。

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Complete the closing idiom — "unprecedented": 前___未有.
turns.answer: 所

turns.speaker: wei
turns.text: 前所未有的进步。下次见！(qián suǒ wèi yǒu de jìn bù. xià cì jiàn!)
turns.spokenText: 前所未有的进步。下次见！

topics.title: Tang poetry foundations
topics.description: 李白, 杜甫, 王维 — the lines every educated speaker can quote

guide.intro: Tang dynasty (618–907) poetry is the cultural reservoir Chinese speakers draw on the way English speakers reach for Shakespeare. You don't need to read every poem — but the half-dozen lines below are quoted in WeChat moments, business toasts, news headlines, and movie titles. Knowing them is the difference between hearing a language and hearing a culture.

sections.text: 李白 — the romantic

Lǐ Bái (701–762), nicknamed 诗仙 (the Poetry Immortal). Famous for moonlit drinking, untethered imagination, and homesickness. His 静夜思 (Quiet Night Thoughts) is the first poem Chinese children memorize.

rows.translation: Before my bed, bright moonlight —
I wondered if it were frost on the ground.
Lifting my head, I gazed at the bright moon —
Lowering it, I thought of my hometown.

sections.text: 故乡 (gù xiāng — hometown) is the most-loaded word in classical Chinese. It still freights modern songs, Lunar New Year speeches, and diaspora literature.

Textual note: the 床前明月光 wording above is the Ming-dynasty redaction (the version every Chinese child memorizes today). The earlier Tang variant reads 床前看月光 / 疑是地上霜 / 举头望山月 / 低头思故乡. If you ever see 看月光 / 望山月 in an academic citation, it isn't a typo — it's the older edition.
杜甫 — the conscience

Dù Fǔ (712–770), 诗圣 (the Poetry Sage). Where Lǐ Bái soars, Dù Fǔ documents — war, hunger, the displaced family. His phrase 国破山河在 ("the nation shattered, mountains and rivers remain") is quoted whenever a country loses something it cannot replace.

rows.translation: The state is broken; the mountains and rivers remain.
Spring in the city — grass and trees grow thick.
Moved by the times, even flowers shed tears.

sections.text: 王维 — the painter-monk

Wáng Wéi (701–761) painted in words and wrote on silk. His couplets are nearly silent: a stream, a bell, a single bird. The phrase 诗中有画，画中有诗 ("poetry in his paintings, paintings in his poetry") was coined to describe him.

rows.translation: Empty mountain — no one in sight.
Only the echo of voices is heard.
Bright moon shines between the pines.

sections.text: 苏轼 — the Song-dynasty bonus

Sū Shì (1037–1101) is technically Song, not Tang, but you cannot graduate without him. His line 但愿人长久，千里共婵娟 ("may we live long and share the moon's beauty across a thousand li") is the standard Mid-Autumn Festival blessing — printed on mooncake boxes nationwide.

rows.translation: May people endure (live long).
And share, across a thousand li, the moon's beauty.

rows.pinyin: Bù shí Lú shān zhēn miàn mù
rows.translation: I cannot see Mount Lu's true face —

rows.pinyin: Zhǐ yuán shēn zài cǐ shān zhōng
rows.translation: Only because I myself am in the mountain.

sections.text: Su Shi's couplet shares a sensibility with the proverb 当局者迷 ("the one inside the game is confused") — but the proverb itself comes from 旧唐书 (the Old Book of Tang), not from 题西林壁. They are quoted side by side because they say the same thing from different angles.

lessons.title: 李白 — moon and home
lessons.description: The 静夜思 quartet

exercises.prompt: 李白 is known by which honorific?
Reassemble: "Lifting my head, I gazed at the bright moon."
exercises.answer: 举 头 望 明 月

exercises.prompt: In 静夜思, what does the poet think the moonlight resembles on the floor? (Answer in English.)
exercises.explanation: 疑是地上霜 — "I wondered if it were frost on the ground." The sleepless homesick image.

exercises.prompt: the line to its theme
A diaspora speaker tells the audience "低头思故乡" — they are signaling:
options: Homesickness, by quoting the most-recognized line in Chinese poetry
A literal description of their posture
exercises.answer: Homesickness, by quoting the most-recognized line in Chinese poetry
exercises.explanation: Quoting 低头思故乡 is the cultural shorthand for missing home — every Chinese speaker recognizes 静夜思 from childhood.

exercises.prompt: Reassemble the full quartet of 静夜思 in correct order.
exercises.answer: 床前 明月 光 疑是 地上 霜 举头 望 明月 低头 思 故乡

exercises.prompt: A speaker recites a line in classical-recital cadence (slow, drawn syllables). Pick what you hear.
exercises.spokenText: 举头望明月，低头思故乡
options: 举头望明月，低头思故乡
床前明月光，疑是地上霜
空山不见人，但闻人语响
海内存知己，天涯若比邻
exercises.answer: 举头望明月，低头思故乡

exercises.prompt: The single most culturally loaded word in 静夜思 — the one that bears the homesick weight — is ___ (2 characters).
exercises.explanation: 故乡 (hometown) is the keyword Chinese diaspora literature, songs, and Lunar New Year speeches all return to. 静夜思 fixed it in the cultural memory.

exercises.prompt: The Tang-era variant of 静夜思 line 1 reads 床前看月光 (not 床前明月光). What does this tell us?
options: Multiple textual traditions exist; 明月光 is the Ming-redaction version that became canonical
Tang poets never wrote 明月
exercises.answer: Multiple textual traditions exist; 明月光 is the Ming-redaction version that became canonical
exercises.explanation: Both 看月光 (Tang) and 明月光 (Ming redaction) survive in different editions. Schoolchildren memorize the Ming version — but in academic citations 看月光 still appears.

exercises.prompt: each Lǐ Bái association to its grounding in his work / reputation

pairs.right: Theme that makes 静夜思 universal

lessons.title: 杜甫 — country and conscience
lessons.description: 国破山河在 and the politics of loss

exercises.prompt: "国破山河在" is most often quoted today when:
options: Mourning a national tragedy or war
exercises.answer: Mourning a national tragedy or war
exercises.explanation: Dù Fǔ wrote it after the An Lushan rebellion sacked the capital. It is the standard quotation for catastrophic national loss.

exercises.prompt: Reassemble: "Moved by the times, even flowers shed tears."
exercises.answer: 感 时 花 溅 泪

exercises.prompt: Dù Fǔ's honorific 诗圣 emphasizes that he was:
options: A moral / Confucian conscience in verse
exercises.answer: A moral / Confucian conscience in verse

exercises.prompt: Reassemble the famous opening couplet of 春望: "The state is broken, mountains and rivers remain; spring in the city, grass and trees grow thick."
exercises.answer: 国 破 山河 在 城 春 草木 深

exercises.prompt: A speaker recites a Dù Fǔ line in literary cadence. Pick what you hear.
exercises.spokenText: 国破山河在，城春草木深
options: 国破山河在，城春草木深
床前明月光，疑是地上霜
空山不见人，但闻人语响
野火烧不尽，春风吹又生
exercises.answer: 国破山河在，城春草木深

exercises.prompt: each Dù Fǔ line to the situation in which a modern editor or speaker would quote it

pairs.right: Mourning a national catastrophe — country lost, land remains
Vivid image of empty wartime city — quoted in war reporting
Quoted to convey grief so deep that nature seems to share it
Honorific — the Confucian conscience in verse

exercises.prompt: Continue the couplet: "国破山河在，___." (5 characters; the standard wartime image.)
acceptableAnswers: 城春草木深 (chéng chūn cǎo mù shēn)
exercises.explanation: 国破山河在，城春草木深 — the most-quoted Dù Fǔ couplet of all time. "The state is broken, mountains and rivers remain; spring in the city, grass and trees grow thick."

exercises.prompt: Which famous historical event is the immediate background to 春望?
options: The fall of Chang'an in the Qin dynasty
exercises.explanation: Dù Fǔ wrote 春望 after rebels sacked Chang'an. The poem's grief is specific to that event — but the lines have outlived it as the canonical image of national catastrophe.

exercises.prompt: A war correspondent's column ends with "国破山河在." The implicit message is:
options: The war is over and we have won
The country has suffered a devastating loss; what remains is the land itself
Nature is more powerful than politics
The reporter has visited a beautiful place
exercises.answer: The country has suffered a devastating loss; what remains is the land itself
exercises.explanation: 国破山河在 is the elegiac frame for catastrophic national loss — the institutions are gone, only mountains and rivers endure. Quoting it carries that weight without spelling it out.

exercises.prompt: Reassemble Dù Fǔ's grief image: "Moved by the times, even flowers shed tears; resenting separation, even birds startle the heart."
exercises.answer: 感 时 花 溅 泪 恨 别 鸟 惊 心

lessons.title: 王维 — paintings without paint
lessons.description: Empty mountains, distant voices

exercises.prompt: Su Shi described 王维 with which line?
exercises.explanation: "In his poetry there is painting; in his painting, poetry." The stock praise for artists who fuse media.

exercises.prompt: Reassemble: "Empty mountain — no one in sight."
exercises.answer: 空 山 不 见 人

exercises.prompt: "明月松间照" describes moonlight shining between ___
Reassemble 王维's quartet from 鹿柴: "Empty mountain — no one in sight; only the echo of voices is heard. Returning light enters the deep forest, casting again on the green moss."
exercises.answer: 空 山 不 见 人 但 闻 人 语 响 返 景 入 深 林 复 照 青 苔 上

exercises.prompt: A literary recital. Pick the line you hear.
exercises.spokenText: 空山不见人，但闻人语响
options: 空山不见人，但闻人语响
明月松间照，清泉石上流
举头望明月，低头思故乡
国破山河在，城春草木深
exercises.answer: 空山不见人，但闻人语响

exercises.prompt: each 王维 line to the kind of sensory image it produces
Su Shi praised Wang Wei's fusion of arts. Which of these accurately captures that praise?
options: 诗中有画，画中有诗 — there is painting in his poetry, poetry in his painting
He wrote in two scripts at once
His verse was as long as his scrolls
exercises.answer: 诗中有画，画中有诗 — there is painting in his poetry, poetry in his painting

exercises.prompt: Continue 王维's couplet: "明月松间照，___." (5 characters)
acceptableAnswers: 清泉石上流 (qīng quán shí shàng liú)
exercises.explanation: 明月松间照，清泉石上流 — bright moon between the pines, a clear spring over the stones. The couplet's parallelism (image + image, no human present) is signature 王维.

exercises.prompt: 王维's nickname 诗佛 (Poetry Buddha) reflects:
options: The Buddhist quietism that pervades his nature poems
His role as a temple priest
His use of Buddhist scripture in verse
exercises.answer: The Buddhist quietism that pervades his nature poems
exercises.explanation: 王维 was a devout lay Buddhist; his late-period nature poems are read as 禅 (Chan) meditation in verse. The honorific 诗佛 captures that quality.

exercises.prompt: Why is 王维's poetry so often described as "silent"?
options: His poems use minimal narrative — image after image with little human presence or argument
He used only one tone class
exercises.answer: His poems use minimal narrative — image after image with little human presence or argument
exercises.explanation: Compare with Dù Fǔ (who tells stories) or Lǐ Bái (who emotes). 王维 selects images and lets them stand — that compositional restraint is what readers call "silent."

lessons.title: 苏轼 — moon for the festival
lessons.description: 千里共婵娟 and 当局者迷

exercises.prompt: "但愿人长久，千里共婵娟" is the canonical greeting for which holiday?
exercises.explanation: Mooncake-box poetry: a wish that family separated by distance can still share the moon.

exercises.prompt: the line to its modern echo (note: 当局者迷 is from 旧唐书, not 苏轼 — but it shares the sensibility)
Reassemble: "Only because I myself am inside this mountain."
exercises.answer: 只 缘 身 在 此 山 中

exercises.prompt: A friend says "你这是当局者迷." They mean:
options: You are too far from the situation to judge
You're too close to the problem to see it clearly
exercises.answer: You're too close to the problem to see it clearly

exercises.prompt: Build the festival blessing: "May people endure long, sharing across a thousand li the moon's beauty."
exercises.answer: 但 愿 人 长 久 千 里 共 婵娟

exercises.prompt: A speaker reads the line printed on every mooncake box. Pick what you hear.
exercises.spokenText: 但愿人长久，千里共婵娟
options: 但愿人长久，千里共婵娟
床前明月光，疑是地上霜
海内存知己，天涯若比邻
国破山河在，城春草木深
exercises.answer: 但愿人长久，千里共婵娟

exercises.prompt: A travel essay closes with "___ 真 面 目 ， 只 缘 身 在 此 山 中." Fill the famous opening of 苏轼's 题西林壁 (5 characters).
exercises.explanation: 不识庐山真面目，只缘身在此山中 — the canonical line for self-blindness. Quoted whenever someone is too close to a situation to perceive it.

exercises.prompt: each 苏轼 line to its modern conversational use

pairs.right: Mid-Autumn / Lunar New Year blessing — wishing endurance
Comforting separated family — sharing the moon
Explaining why one is too close to see clearly

exercises.prompt: 苏轼 belongs to which dynasty? (Trick: he is paired with Tang poets but lived later.)
exercises.explanation: Sū Shì (1037–1101) is a Song-dynasty figure. His couplets are quoted alongside Tang poetry but stylistically belong to a later, more reflective era.

exercises.prompt: Source check: "当局者迷" comes from where?
options: 旧唐书 (the Old Book of Tang)
exercises.answer: 旧唐书 (the Old Book of Tang)
exercises.explanation: 当局者迷 is from 旧唐书, NOT from 题西林壁. The two are quoted together because they say the same thing — but the proverb has its own source. Knowing this is a marker of literary literacy.

lessons.title: Tang lines in active modern use
lessons.description: Phrases you'll meet at toasts, on classroom walls, and in WeChat moments

exercises.prompt: "海内存知己，天涯若比邻" (王勃) is most often quoted at:
options: Farewells / send-offs — toasting a friend who's moving away
exercises.answer: Farewells / send-offs — toasting a friend who's moving away
exercises.explanation: "If we have a true friend within the four seas, the ends of the earth feel like next door." The standard farewell toast — said when someone is leaving for a long stretch.

exercises.prompt: the famous line to its everyday use

pairs.left: 海内存知己，天涯若比邻
pairs.right: Farewell toast — distance won't break friendship

pairs.left: 谁知盘中餐，粒粒皆辛苦

pairs.left: 离离原上草，一岁一枯荣
pairs.right: Kindergarten poem 草 by 白居易 — resilience

pairs.left: 野火烧不尽，春风吹又生
pairs.right: Same poem — quoted to praise resilience

exercises.prompt: A grandparent scolds a child wasting rice with "谁知盘中餐，___". The implied second line is:
exercises.explanation: From 李绅's 悯农 — "every grain comes from labor." Memorized by every Chinese child; quoted at the dinner table whenever food is wasted.

exercises.prompt: Reassemble the opening of 白居易's 草: "On the plain, grass — once a year withers and flourishes."
exercises.answer: 离离 原上 草 一岁 一 枯荣

exercises.prompt: Continuing 白居易's 草: "野火烧不尽，___". (5 characters; the canonical resilience line.)
acceptableAnswers: 春风吹又生 (chūn fēng chuī yòu shēng)
exercises.explanation: "Wildfire cannot burn it all out — spring wind blows it back to life." Quoted whenever something written off keeps coming back.

exercises.prompt: A speaker reads a Tang line in a literary tone. Pick what you hear.
exercises.spokenText: 海内存知己，天涯若比邻
options: 海内存知己，天涯若比邻
举头望明月，低头思故乡
国破山河在，城春草木深
野火烧不尽，春风吹又生
exercises.answer: 海内存知己，天涯若比邻

exercises.prompt: Build the farewell toast: "Within the four seas a true friend remains; the ends of the earth feel like next door."
exercises.answer: 海 内 存 知 己 天 涯 若 比 邻

exercises.prompt: A teacher gently reminds a child throwing rice on the floor with "谁知盘中餐." The pedagogical move is:
options: Quote a poem the child has memorized to evoke shared moral knowledge
exercises.answer: Quote a poem the child has memorized to evoke shared moral knowledge
exercises.explanation: By naming only the first half, the teacher cues the child to silently complete 粒粒皆辛苦. The didactic move depends on the child knowing the line by heart — and every Chinese child does.

exercises.prompt: each famous everyday-Tang line to its situational trigger

pairs.left: 海内存知己，天涯若比邻
野火烧不尽，春风吹又生
pairs.right: Praising resilience — what is written off comes back

pairs.left: 谁知盘中餐，粒粒皆辛苦
举头望明月，低头思故乡

exercises.prompt: A grandparent recites a children's poem at dinner. Pick the line you hear.

options: 谁知盘中餐，粒粒皆辛苦
海内存知己，天涯若比邻
明月松间照，清泉石上流
但愿人长久，千里共婵娟
exercises.answer: 谁知盘中餐，粒粒皆辛苦
exercises.explanation: From 李绅's 悯农 — every Chinese child memorizes it. The recital cadence (slow, steady) is unmistakable in family contexts.
